ann darnell.name: Ann Darnell
ann darnell.species: Human mutated from cosmic ray exposure
ann darnell.origin: Alongside her younger brother Jimmy, Ann joined millionaire Simon Utrecht and pilot Mike Steel in an experiment to simulate the crash that gave the Fantastic Four their powers. Ann joined the group as she wished for more than merely fame, she desired great power. Aboard the unshielded spacecraft, the group located the cosmic storm area. Suddenly, they were bombarded with cosmic rays, and the turbulence caused Ann to stumble back into the life-support cylinders. Both her mask and the cylinders cracked, with a mixture of gases seeping into her lungs. The four were quickly rescued by Bruce Banner, who had witnessed the expedition. The ship crashed to Earth and the U-Foes emerged. Now calling herself Vapor, Ann attacked Banner when he revealed he had been the one to return their spaceship. Soon, however, the U-Foes discovered that Banner was really the Incredible Hulk. After her teammates failed to defeat the Hulk, Vapor started to suffocate him, gloating as he was unable to hurt her physically. However, when Vector joined in the battle, he unintentionally deflected Vapor from the superhero and into her brother, X-Ray, causing Vapor's hydrogen form to light ablaze with fire. Her teammates attempted to save her, but she managed to regain her physical form and put out the fire herself. Before the U-Foes could continue their battle with the Hulk, they started to lose control over their new powers. Vapor's physical body reverted back to mist and her atoms started to dissipate. In a last ditch effort, Vapor attempted to help Vector, but his powers deflected her and scattered her to the wind. Alongside her teammates, she has had encounters with heroes including Hulk, the Avengers, Spider-Man, Crossfire, Puma, Darkhawk, and Portal. During the Acts of Vengeance, Vapor attempted to kill the Scarlet Witch. Vapor and the other U-Foes were recently recruited to serve Norman Osborn in his scheming, and have since joined the Hood's Gang. This arrangement ended after Norman Osborn fell from power following his attack on Asgard. Vapor, along with the rest of the U-Foes, were recruited by Henry Peter Gyrich to hunt down the Hulk, given free rein to do so. As part of a cruel game, she tormented the Hulk as a noxious gas. After X-Ray's cosmic radiation allowed Hulk's Joe Fixit persona to emerge with new strength, she tried to suffocate the Hulk as sulfuric acid, only to blind Vector when she was breathed out. Afterwards, Vapor and her team were hired for an undisclosed job which led to a confrontation with the Spider-Men. Stealing an item at Empire State University, she and X-Ray performed a radioactive combo attack which hospitalized the original Spider-Man, but they were subsequently apprehended by the newer one. While in custody awaiting imprisonment, she was approached by May Parker who needed a biological sample of her to develop a cure for her nephew, Peter, who was a casualty of her fight with the Spider-Men. Coming to appreciate May's maternal empathy shown towards her, Ann agreed to help then gave the sample she needed, and the two pleasantly parted ways.

ann dodgson.name: Ann Dodgson
ann dodgson.origin: Ann Dodgson was married to Edward Stanford, and had a twin sister, Clare, who was a detective. Clare's testimony threatened the local crimelord, Nemesis, so Nemesis' goons abducted Stanford and invaded his home, taking Ann and her kids hostage. Coming to their house for dinner, Clare was alerted to the situation by the natural mental link she shared with her twin. Clare got the jump on the thugs, and soon the Unipower joined the fight, turning both sisters into Captain Universe simultaneously. The Captains Universe used a combination of their powers and Clare's investigative skills to track down Nemesis' hideout, defeat his hoods, and corner the boss, but Ann's husband was nowhere to be found. When they unmasked Nemesis, it was revealed to have been Stanford all along, playing both sides of the law as crimelord and D.A. Disgusted, Ann punched him out and let the police take him away. The sisters returned to the Stanford home and the Unipower departed as Ann prepared to take on the challenge of raising her children alone.

ann fraley.name: Ann Fraley
ann fraley.origin: Ann Fraley was a professional female wrestler in her youth, wrestling under the name 'Auntie Freeze'. After retiring as a wrestler herself, she became the manager to a group of four younger female wrestlers, Davida DeVito (known as Titania), Melissa Gold (known as Screaming Mimi), Marian Pouncy (known as Poundcakes), and Hellen Feliciano (known as Letha), who collectively became known as the Grapplers. The Grapplers' careers, however, weren't as successful as their male counterparts, however, and they drifted into petty crime. Eventually, the four wrestlers made a deal with the criminal Roxxon Oil company, who gave the women special powers and equipment so they could commit crimes on their behalf. The Grapplers' schemes were often thwarted, however, and they were imprisoned at least once. Eventually, Auntie Freeze was approached by the Power Broker, who offered her the chance to have her clients' strength increased to superhuman levels thanks to his strength-boosting treatments, Auntie Freeze agreed, and the Grapplers' strength was increased. Auntie Freeze also recruited a number of other female wrestlers to join the Grapplers and had their strength boosted too. As a result, the Grapplers were eligible to join the Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation and became its female division, welcoming the respectability it provided, away from their life of crime. Shortly thereafter, two of the Grapplers, Titania and Letha, were murdered by the assassins known as the Scourge of the Underworld (though they were later mystically resurrected). The Grapplers and the UCWF eventually disbanded, with many of the Grapplers turning to crime (and in the case of Melissa Gold eventually becoming a superhero under the name of Songbird). Auntie Freeze's current activities are unknown.

ann johnson.origin: Member of the North Carolina State Assembly. She presided over the meeting in the town of Marion to publicly condemn the Hulk for his actions and for which he was captured by the Juggernaut in collaboration with the Damage Control. She appealed to the assembled people saying that even if the Hulk could not be prosecuted and would not remain their prisoner for long, at least on that occasion he would listen to the anger of the citizens and the pain he had caused.

ann keats.name: Ann Keats
ann keats.origin: Dracula walked into a disco bar, where he met a woman named Ann Keats. Keats explained that she was recently divorced and invited Dracula to come home with her. Along the way. she told Dracula her life story. When she asked what Dracula was doing in New York City, he told her that he was looking for his daughter. When she asked if he knew where she was, he told her he did not. Ann followed after him, and the two were soon attacked by muggers. Despite the fact that they were outnumbered and Dracula was injured in the fight, Dracula easily defeated their attackers. When Ann asked how he did that, Dracula told her his real name. When he heard police sirens, he told her he must go. Ann took him back to her home, unaware that they were being stalked by the 'Cowboy'. At Ann's apartment, Dracula told her his life story, however she found it more than a little hard to believe. Noticing that she had a phone, Dracula asked if he might call his wife Domini. He told Domini what he was doing in New York and although she accepted it, she was saddened that Dracula would wish to turn himself back into a vampire. After Dracula was off the phone, the Cowboy burst into Ann's apartment with guns blazing. As Ann called the cops for help, Dracula managed to get the better of the Cowboy in a hand-to-hand fight. The battle ended with Dracula throwing the bounty hunter off the roof of the apartment building to his death. Ann came to his side to tell Dracula that an ambulance was on its way as Dracula passes out from blood loss.

When she asked if he knew where she was, he told her he did not. Ann followed after him, and the two were soon attacked by muggers. Despite the fact that they were outnumbered and Dracula was injured in the fight, Dracula easily defeated their attackers. When Ann asked how he did that, Dracula told her his real name. When he heard police sirens, he told her he must go. Ann took him back to her home, unaware that they were being stalked by the 'Cowboy'. At Ann's apartment, Dracula told her his life story, however she found it more than a little hard to believe. Noticing that she had a phone, Dracula asked if he might call his wife Domini. He told Domini what he was doing in New York and although she accepted it, she was saddened that Dracula would wish to turn himself back into a vampire. After Dracula was off the phone, the Cowboy burst into Ann's apartment with guns blazing. As Ann called the cops for help, Dracula managed to get the better of the Cowboy in a hand-to-hand fight. The battle ended with Dracula throwing the bounty hunter off the roof of the apartment building to his death. Ann came to his side to tell Dracula that an ambulance was on its way as Dracula passes out from blood loss.

ann norton.name: Ann Norton
ann norton.origin: Anne Norton lived in the town of Sundown, Arizona with her father during the days of the American Frontier. When she was 18 years old she began dating Clay Harder who was becoming a well reputed as a fast draw and a great shot. Soon outlaws came to Sundown to try and make a reputation for themselves by trying to outdraw Harder. After an outlaw named Diego Simms tried his luck while Clay was out with Anne for dinner one night, her father was witness as Clay won the fight. Forbidding his daughter to see a gunfighter, Mr. Norton slapped Clay across the face. Shammed, Clay left town and he eventually became the legendary Two-Gun Kid . Many years later, Sundown was terrorized by the Dalton gang prompting Anne to send out a letter asking the Two-Gun Kid for help. Before he arrive, Anne and her father were harassed by the gang, and local banker Jeff Smith came to her defence but the outlaws just shoved him aside. The Kid soon arrived in town and subdued the Dalton gang. While Anne still harboured feelings for the Kid, her father's long ago recriminations still stuck to him and told her that she shouldn't be a gunfighter, suggesting that she pursue a romance with Jeff Smith before riding out of her life seemingly for good . Anne's subsequent activities are unknown.

ann raymond.name: Ann Raymond
ann raymond.origin: Ann Raymond is the wife of Toro. When Toro died, she later became involved in a plot with enemies of Toro's allies, the Invaders. After she was freed, she became very close with Toro's mentor and best friend, Jim Hammond, the original Human Torch. Hammond faked his death, and Ann Raymond appeared to travel with Jim as his companion. Toro has more recently been revived due to a disruption to the Earth-616 timestream, but the two of them have not reconciled. Ann Raymond was Katie Power's elementary school teacher.

ann reynolds.name: Ann Reynolds
ann reynolds.origin: Ann Reynolds struggled all her life against the preconceived ideas of those who belittled her intelligence because of her gender, ending up as assistant to Dr. Raymond Corey. Along with Corey and two others, Jim Scully and Jeff Turner, she was thrown backwards in time when the plane they were in passed through the Bermuda Triangle, and Ann suddenly found herself in the middle of a struggle for survival. She and her comrades were eventually rescued by the Thing.

anna ameyama.name: Anna Ameyama
anna ameyama.origin: ===Origins=== Anna Ameyama was an aspiring chef who learned many of her culinary skills from her uncle, Edwin Jarvis. After completing her courses at the Culinary Institute, she cooked in kitchens all over the world, including the U.S., Taiwan, Japan, Italy, and Mexico. After "paying her dues", she decided to try her luck on her own and began operating a food truck in New York City. Unfortunately, her truck was destroyed by Iron Man during a battle with Fin Fang Foom. After he came back to check up on her, he tried one of her tortas and was so impressed he hired her as his new chef. ===Working for Tony Stark=== On her first day of work for Stark Industries, Anna met her new robotic assistant M.I.K.A. Together, Anna and M.I.K.A. created a miso-hinted clams with pasta for Tony Stark and his guest, Emma Frost. Not long after starting work at Stark Industries, Anna was flown to Connecticut to cater Janet Van Dyne's birthday dinner with Tony, Thor, She-Hulk, Black Panther, Tigra, and Captain America in attendance. Using a secret recipe from her uncle, Anna cooked barbecue glazed chicken with a chili mustard marinade, cornbread, and coleslaw. On Halloween, Anna was tasked with creating a menu for the annual "Halloween F.E.A.S.T. Feast". Despite Tony suggesting pumpkin spiced waffles, Anna created a pumpkin-squash soup with a balsamic reduction that allowed everyone to customize their own "jack-o'-lanterns". Anna was especially busy during the week of Thanksgiving preparing for Stark's numerous Thanksgiving dinners, but she was able to rest on the Friday after Thanksgiving. Using leftovers, Anna and her roommate M'Betu created Thanksgiving dumplings. Thoroughly impressed by her cooking at Janet's birthday, Thor brought Anna to Asgard to cater a birthday feast for his mother, Lady Freyja. At Thor's request, Anna and Alida made a vegan succotash. Around Christmas, Tony Stark finally made good on replacing Anna's food truck. However, now she was left with a decision to make: stay working with Stark Industries or go out on her own. Needing guidance, Anna decided to turn to her Uncle Jarvis.

anna anokhin.name: Anna Anokhin
anna anokhin.origin: Black Widow received the call to atone for one of her acts as an assassin: years ago she killed a young scientist named Peter Anokhin in front of his wife. Clint knew about it and insisted on going with her. Spider-Woman didn't like the idea of her boyfriend going off alone with his ex so she insisted on coming along as well. They headed to Siberia to meet up with Anokhin's widow Anna, but she wanted nothing to do with Natasha. The marker was actually sent by her daughter Galina's boyfriend Karl, who wanted the Black Widow's help to find Galina, whom Anna believed to be dead. Reunited with her daughter thanks to the Black Widow, Anna still doesn't want to see Natasha ever again, but nonetheless offered her thanks in the form of Peter's journal, consisting of formulae and antidotes for everything they were working on, as well as personal notes to give Natasha some insight into the kind of man he was.

anna beame.name: Anna Beame
anna beame.origin: Anna Beame was killed for witchcraft because she gave birth to a son whose eyes were glowing. Her son Nathan used his powers to reanimate his mother's corpse, then transported her and her father to an underground city he created and kept his mother alive despite her body continuing to decay. In the end, however, the Ghost Rider set her on fire and threw her against Nathan's protective sphere thus destroying her body.

anna brisson.first_appearance: Jessica Jones: Purple Daughter - Marvel Digital Original Vol 1 1
anna brisson.origin: Anna Brisson was a member of the Killgrave Support Group who was there the night Jessica Jones came in hopes of finding some clues to the location of Zebediah Killgrave. When it was Anna's turn to speak, Jessica did not believe her testimony, and accused Anna of being a liar, which got Jessica kicked out of the group. thumb|left|Anna flying away from the fight Jessica stayed behind in order to follow Anna home, and as she made her way down a dark alley, Jessica lost sight of her until a hard punch to the face knocked Jessica into a dumpster. She realized that Anna had some sort of abilities, since she was able to go toe-to-toe with her, and ended up getting the upper hand by chocking Jessica. Jessica countered Anna and shoved her to the ground, so that she could tell her all she wanted to do was have a coffee with her, but Anna got out of there quickly by flying away. A report on the news, which Jessica was watching later that night, mentioned that Anna had killed herself by jumping off a building, but since she was known to be a Nuhuman with the the ability to fly, the reporter questioned whether it was a real suicide as Anna seemingly had no history of depression nor mental illness. Jessica later went to Anna's parents' home to find any clues about the incident, but Anna's father slammed the door in her face and was then seen through the window telling his grieving wife that the vultures never give up.

anna brooks.name: Anna Brooks
anna brooks.origin: Reporter Anna Brooks was the first one to investigate the Wendigo case for the press. She then met photographer Peter Parker, who was also covering the case for the Daily Bugle. When Parker suggested that someone in town killed those two boys, she strongly refused to consider it and accused him of professional jealousy. When finally Chief Inspector Krahn was revealed to be the real killer, Anna's article ended up in Section B page 20 of her paper.

anna coye.name: Anna Coye
anna coye.origin: Anna Coye was a friend of Miguel O'Hara. Miguel accompanied Anna to visit her sister Carrie who was admitted to ESU Hospital due to her degenerative genetic disease. While there there was an assault on the hospital by Mutagen who wanted to eliminate all genetic aberrations, so Miguel came out of Carrie's room with an excuse and transformed into Spider-Man to confront Mutagen, but during the fight, the two contenders broke through the ceiling of Carrie's bedroom knocking Anna out with the rubble. When Anna came to, the fight between Spider-Man and Mutagen was over and Anna found Carrie safe and sound. A few days later Anna and Miguel took a tour of Helix, a subsidiary of Alchemax, which had developed a prototype DNA scanner. During the tour, Mutagen stormed the Helix building with the intention of stealing the prototype so that he could easily find those people he considered genetic aberrations. During the assault, Mutagen recognized Anna and thought that since her sister had a genetic disease she too must have the same genetic disorder and was therefore intent on killing her; Miguel defended her but was hit by Mutagen when he was not yet transformed into Spider-Man so that Anna saw that Miguel could adhere to the walls. While trying to escape, taking advantage of the moment that Mutagen and Spider-Man were fighting, she was hit in the head by the rubble thrown by Mutagen that knocked her unconscious and when she awoke she discovered that she had suffered a head injury that had caused her a form of amnesia, thus not remembering the moments of Mutagen's attack and therefore also of Miguel's powers.

anna frankenstein.name: Anna Frankenstein
anna frankenstein.origin: The direct relation between Anna Frankenstein and her father to the legendary Frankenstein family is unknown. They took up residence in Castle Frankenstein following the death of Basil Frankenstein. Anna became loyal to the Nazis' cause and after becoming the love to a blind Nazi agent named Von Rottz, she became determined to use the family secrets to create her own version of the Frankenstein's Monster. After successfully creating the new monster without her father's knowledge, Anna sent a letter to Captain America and Bucky asking for their "assistance" so that she could set her creation against them. When the two heroes arrived, Anna begged them to investigate some "strange happenings" around the house in the hopes of using her monster to kill them. Later that night, Captain America and Bucky were attacked by the monster but forced it to flee. Cap gathered the Doctor, Anna, and his staff and went to search for the monster with the aid of Von Rottz. The creature attacked the heroes again and strangled Von Rottz to death. He then grabbed Anna and fled into the countryside. Captain America followed after the creature and freed Anna then tricked the monster into walking over a quicksand pit. Cap then confronted Anna with the truth, and in shame, she committed suicide by jumping into the quicksand as well. Unable to tell Frankenstein that his daughter was a traitor, Cap informed the Doctor that his daughter was killed by the monster before he could rescue her. Blaming Anna's death on the family curse, the Doctor then set the castle's laboratory on fire. The destruction of the lab did not destroy all of Victor Frankenstein's work as other members of his family have since been able to carry on their work.

anna kapplebaum.name: Anna Kapplebaum
anna kapplebaum.species: Anna grew up in a Nazi concentration camp during World War II.
anna kapplebaum.origin: left|thumb|Anna at Diebenwald, 1945 Anna Kapplebaum was born in Germany in the year 1926. On November 9th, 1938, Nazi Germany initiated a pogrom which became known as Kristallnacht (the Night of Broken Glass). SS soldiers rioted the streets, collecting Jewish families and herding them into freight trains. Anna’s family was loaded on board and told that they were being taken to a distant work camp “for their own protection”. They remained in a cramped train cabin for three days until they reached Diebenwald. Anna soon learned that Diebenwald was not a work center, but a death camp. The old and infirm were executed immediately, and the able-bodied were put to work. The commandant of the camp was a fierce soldier named Colonel Steiger. Anna's parents were executed and she was separated from her brothers and sisters. In the Spring of 1945, Germany realized that the war was nearly lost, and the Allied Forces would soon liberate the concentration camps. Colonel Steiger ordered all records destroyed and all witnesses executed. Before such a task could be met, however, the patriotic hero Captain America stormed the gates of Diebenwald and attacked the Nazis. Colonel Steiger grabbed Anna Kapplebaum as a hostage and held a gun to her head. Cap flung his shield, disarming Steiger, then punched him until he fell unconscious. He took nineteen-year-old Anna in his arms and told her that the war was over. Years later Anna immigrated to the United States. As an elderly woman, she took up residence in a first level apartment at 569 Leaman Place in Brooklyn Heights. She became somewhat of a surrogate mother to many of the other tenants including Josh Cooper and Steve Rogers. Upon meeting Rogers, Anna felt a close kinship with him, little realizing that he was the same man who rescued her from the Nazi death camps nearly half a century earlier. At a butcher shop, Anna ran into Doctor Mendelhaus, one of the Nazis who had tortured her when she was in Diebenwald. She fainted at his sight and later woke up in a hospital bed. There she was visited by Aaron Heller and his daughter Marie, a Nazi hunter who was after Mendelhaus. After she left the hospital, Anna was kidnapped by a group of Nazis who worked together with Mendelhaus and brought her to him before she could assist in his capture. Luckily, she was saved just in time by Captain America and Aaron and Marie Heller.

anna maria marconi.name: Anna Maria Marconi
anna maria marconi.origin: Anna Maria Marconi was a student at Empire State University, where she met Otto Octavius, who was in the body of Peter Parker. She dated "Peter Parker", and was very supportive of Peter's pursuits, she has developed fish with a bioluminescent gene, to be used as a green energy light source. During the period where the Goblin Army assaulted New York, Anna was unknowingly kidnapped by Menace, who was in her human guise, lying to Anna that Mary Jane had sent her to get Anna out of the city safely. Anna was eventually rescued by Peter, who had reclaimed his body due to the sacrifice of Otto Octavius. Anna, in the aftermath, determined that Peter was in fact Spider-Man as well as that he had "planned" to propose. She was unaware that during that time, Octavius was in control. When Peter returned home, Anna confronted him with this knowledge. Peter chose to disclose to her not only that he was Spider-Man, but that Octavius was in control since before they met. Anna, surprisingly, took the information in stride though left for few hours to process this new truth. When she returned Anna offered to assist Peter in the project that Octavius was overseeing. She also offered information about the events that had unfolded while he was "away." Peter in turn promised to help her in any way, such as promising that she would always have a place at his company and he would let her stay in their apartment for as long as she needed to.

anna marie lebeau.name: Anna Marie LeBeau
anna marie lebeau.origin: ===Girl on the Run=== left|thumb|Young Anna Marie and her mother Anna Marie was born to Priscilla and Owen in a back-to-nature hippie commune in Caldecott County, Mississippi. She was delivered by her aunt Carrie, her mother's sister. Although the prude Carrie believed Owen had ruined Priscilla's life, she still maintained a relationship with Priscilla and Anna Marie, who frequently visited her in their family's ancestral farmhouse. However, after Carrie reprimanded Priscilla for sharing the commune's attempt to use Native American mysticism to reach an ethereal plane known as the Far Banks, the sisters cut ties with each other. The ritual resulted in Priscilla's disappearance. Owen informed Carrie about the incident and left Anna Marie under her care while asking her to move in to the commune, which she refused. In her grief at the loss of her sister, Carrie proved to be a strict and authoritarian guardian to protect her niece. This led Anna Marie to be a rebellious child. Her poor relationship with her rigid aunt and distant father prompted her to run away from home as a kid. Fending for herself as a loner, the young girl was nicknamed by the locals as "Rogue", which became the only name she would go by. The skittish Rogue was approached by a warm-hearted Mystique, a mutant shapeshifter. Since Mystique was an outcast herself, Rogue trusted her. Mystique took Rogue in on the advice of her precognitive partner, Destiny. As part of a family, Rogue enjoyed happy moments with her mothers. However, due to Destiny's knowledge about the future, Mystique was secretly aware of Rogue's condition as a mutant and, in fact, had plans of using Rogue in her mission as a mutant terrorist. At some point, Rogue grew close to a boy named Cody Robbins. Mystique feared for their relationship, wishing to prevent any development from it. Still, during their flirtation, Rogue impulsively kissed Robbins, at which point her latent mutant power to absorb the life energy and psyche of others with skin-to-skin contact emerged. Cody Robbins was left in a coma from which he would not awaken. Rogue was traumatized by the experience, breaking her spirit to the point of embracing Mystique's mission. Not able to control her absorption powers at first, Rogue usually wore body-concealing clothing that eliminated the possibility of accidental skin contact. Now having powers, Rogue was introduced by Mystique to crime as part of her Brotherhood of Evil Mutants. Soon, in their secret missions, Rogue realized how dreadful her powers could be as she shared her mind with those she acted against through touch. ===Ms. Marvel=== One of Destiny's visions predicted that the super-heroine Carol Danvers, the mighty Ms. Marvel, would ruin Rogue's life. In order to protect Rogue, Mystique had her Brotherhood attack Ms. Marvel with no success, leading to their arrest. Noticing Mystique's fury, Rogue decided to deal with their enemy by herself in secrecy. Learning Ms. Marvel would be in San Francisco, Rogue tackled her, wishing to prove her worth to the eyes of the Brotherhood. During a fight at the Golden Gate Bridge, Rogue's powers interacted with Ms. Marvel in an unexpected way: Rogue absorbed Ms. Marvel's alien-based powers and memories permanently. Rogue gained Ms. Marvel's incredible strength, near-invulnerability, the power of flight, but her psyche was fractured in the process, ironically consummating Destiny's prediction. Rogue disposed of the apparently lifeless body of Danvers, who was saved by Spider-Woman. Rogue's loneliness, envy, bitterness, and despair turned into anger. Wielding Ms. Marvel's abilities, she was ordered to defeat the Avengers, attacking them at their mansion headquarters in order to acquire enough power to break the arrested Brotherhood members free. Rogue was able to incapacitate Captain America and Thor, but was forced to retreat for not being able to subdue Wonder Man with her absorption powers. After regrouping with the Brotherhood at the prison on Ryker's Island, Rogue battled the Avengers one more time. The Avengers prevailed, prompting Mystique to escape with Rogue. Danvers was psychically treated by the telepath Professor Charles Xavier of the mutant group known as the X-Men, adversaries of Mystique and the Brotherhood. Unbeknownst to them, Mystique had secretly set base at the Pentagon. When Danvers and the X-Men Storm and Wolverine invaded the Pentagon to delete data they had on the X-Men, Rogue was casually seen by her victim. Danvers immediately unleashed her rage upon her aggressor, but Rogue proved to be a formidable foe, forcing Storm to send her out of the battle site with a cyclone. ===Sisterhood of Evil Mutants=== Soon after, Mystique and Rogue envisioned a plan to free their teammates from the Windust Maximum Security Prison. However, after Carrie reprimanded Priscilla for sharing the commune's attempt to use Native American mysticism to reach an ethereal plane known as the Far Banks, the sisters cut ties with each other. The ritual resulted in Priscilla's disappearance. Owen informed Carrie about the incident and left Anna Marie under her care while asking her to move in to the commune, which she refused. In her grief at the loss of her sister, Carrie proved to be a strict and authoritarian guardian to protect her niece. This led Anna Marie to be a rebellious child. Her poor relationship with her rigid aunt and distant father prompted her to run away from home as a kid. Fending for herself as a loner, the young girl was nicknamed by the locals as "Rogue", which became the only name she would go by. The skittish Rogue was approached by a warm-hearted Mystique, a mutant shapeshifter. Since Mystique was an outcast herself, Rogue trusted her. Mystique took Rogue in on the advice of her precognitive partner, Destiny. As part of a family, Rogue enjoyed happy moments with her mothers. However, due to Destiny's knowledge about the future, Mystique was secretly aware of Rogue's condition as a mutant and, in fact, had plans of using Rogue in her mission as a mutant terrorist. At some point, Rogue grew close to a boy named Cody Robbins. Mystique feared for their relationship, wishing to prevent any development from it. Still, during their flirtation, Rogue impulsively kissed Robbins, at which point her latent mutant power to absorb the life energy and psyche of others with skin-to-skin contact emerged. Cody Robbins was left in a coma from which he would not awaken. Rogue was traumatized by the experience, breaking her spirit to the point of embracing Mystique's mission. Not able to control her absorption powers at first, Rogue usually wore body-concealing clothing that eliminated the possibility of accidental skin contact. Now having powers, Rogue was introduced by Mystique to crime as part of her Brotherhood of Evil Mutants. Soon, in their secret missions, Rogue realized how dreadful her powers could be as she shared her mind with those she acted against through touch. ===Ms. Marvel=== One of Destiny's visions predicted that the super-heroine Carol Danvers, the mighty Ms. Marvel, would ruin Rogue's life. In order to protect Rogue, Mystique had her Brotherhood attack Ms. Marvel with no success, leading to their arrest. Noticing Mystique's fury, Rogue decided to deal with their enemy by herself in secrecy. Learning Ms. Marvel would be in San Francisco, Rogue tackled her, wishing to prove her worth to the eyes of the Brotherhood. During a fight at the Golden Gate Bridge, Rogue's powers interacted with Ms. Marvel in an unexpected way: Rogue absorbed Ms. Marvel's alien-based powers and memories permanently. Rogue gained Ms. Marvel's incredible strength, near-invulnerability, the power of flight, but her psyche was fractured in the process, ironically consummating Destiny's prediction. Rogue disposed of the apparently lifeless body of Danvers, who was saved by Spider-Woman. Rogue's loneliness, envy, bitterness, and despair turned into anger. Wielding Ms. Marvel's abilities, she was ordered to defeat the Avengers, attacking them at their mansion headquarters in order to acquire enough power to break the arrested Brotherhood members free. Rogue was able to incapacitate Captain America and Thor, but was forced to retreat for not being able to subdue Wonder Man with her absorption powers. After regrouping with the Brotherhood at the prison on Ryker's Island, Rogue battled the Avengers one more time. The Avengers prevailed, prompting Mystique to escape with Rogue. Danvers was psychically treated by the telepath Professor Charles Xavier of the mutant group known as the X-Men, adversaries of Mystique and the Brotherhood. Unbeknownst to them, Mystique had secretly set base at the Pentagon. When Danvers and the X-Men Storm and Wolverine invaded the Pentagon to delete data they had on the X-Men, Rogue was casually seen by her victim. Danvers immediately unleashed her rage upon her aggressor, but Rogue proved to be a formidable foe, forcing Storm to send her out of the battle site with a cyclone. ===Sisterhood of Evil Mutants=== Soon after, Mystique and Rogue envisioned a plan to free their teammates from the Windust Maximum Security Prison. fields.notes: The exact chronology of Rogue's origins have been revisited more than once. In , Rogue first mentions how her powers activated when she touched Cody Robbins, prompting her to run away. It was not explicit whether or not she had already been taken in by Mystique by then. The story in which Rogue touches Cody Robbins is explored in detail in . In this story, Rogue was already Mystique's protégée even before her powers had activated. Robbins is erroneously named "Freddy" in this story, a mistake that was explained in as Rogue's own confusion about the situation. In , Mystique approached Rogue after her powers had already manifested by having touched Robbins. It is stated that Rogue had run away due to having harmed Robbins. The events depicted in contradict Robbins' condition portrayed in . Originally, Robbins was momentarily stunned by Rogue's contact while in later stories he never woke up from the coma she had put him in. In , Rogue states Mystique was the one who baptized her with her mutant name. Rogue was seen in being lynched by a mob who attacked her in response to Robbins' coma. It was not revealed whether she had already met Mystique by that moment or not. According to Operation Zero Tolerance's Rogue sub-file 100349, after her powers manifested, she was attacked by a monster calling itself "Rogue", who absorbed her and took her appearance. The story reported in the file is only compatible with the interpretation of the events in which Mystique met Rogue after the incident with Robbins. However, the files, as represented in , are usually considered to be false, with the purpose of misleading the X-Men. With the revelation of Rogue's biological family in , it was revealed that what drove her out of her own home as a fugitive was her relationship with her aunt. In the most recent depiction of her origins, in , Mystique met a prepubescent Rogue due to Destiny's recommendation, arguing Rogue would fall into the hands of ill-intended manipulators. In this scenario, it seems unlikely that Rogue had already had her powers activated and her status as a mutant was only known due to Destiny's predictive powers. Steve Rogers considered that Rogue would be a great asset to any team as leader or second-in-command, and would benefit teams of new generation heroes like the Runaways or the Young Masters, and that she would be the perfect candidate to lead the Thunderbolts if Luke Cage was to step down from that position. He would later make her leader of the Avengers Unity Division.
fields.trivia: upright=1.2|thumb|right|In her 4th appearance, Rogue kisses Rom, and in doing so, absorbs more than just his powers. The first time it was suggested that Rogue could turn good was in Rom #32, where the mutant kisses the Spaceknight known as Rom in an attempt to steal his powers, but ends up absorbing his courage and heroism. While the effect is of course temporary, experiencing these emotions (perhaps for the first time) leaves an imprint on Rogue that becomes one of her biggest inspirations to correct her path and subsequently join the X-Men. Writers Bill Mantlo (Rom) and Chris Claremont (Uncanny X-Men) collaborated frequently during the 80's, so it's quite possible that it was Mantlo who originally proposed the idea of ​​redeeming Rogue, and then Claremont played along. Likewise, there's also the possibility that Claremont had already conceived the concept beforehand, and Mantlo, knowing his future intentions for the character, simply decided to implement the first hints in Roms pages. The briefly hinted romance between Rogue and Rom was never revisited. Rogue is known as "Malicia" in French, "Titania" in Latin American Spanish, "Pícara" in European Spanish, "Vampira" in Portuguese, "Шельма" in Russian (also "Руж" in X-Men: Evolution and Wolverine and the X-Men), Vadóc in Hungarian, and was known as "Parasit" in Danish and "Ruda" in Polish. The issue in which Rogue joins the X-Men was voted the 49th greatest Marvel Comic of all time. Rogue was #5 on IGN's Top Twenty-Five X-Men list, and #4 on their Top Ten X-Babes list and #3 on Marvel's list of Top 10 Toughest Females for 2009 and was given title of #1 X-Man on CBR's Top 50 X-Men of All Time for 2008. Depending on the writer, Rogue's dialogue usually has 'I' replaced with 'Ah' to emphasize her southern accent. This is not the case all the time, however. Rogue reflects the stereotype of a southern belle, a woman in the South who is beautiful, flirtatious, yet chaste. Rogue's absorption of Genis-Vell's cosmic powers during was meant to be a long-lasting consequence of House of M; however, the X-Men-related books weren't interested in following this plot point, so the power upgrade only lasted as long as House of M.

anna reynolds.name: Anna Reynolds
anna reynolds.origin: When Dracula rode a train from Germany to Transylvania, he attempted to feed on a young mother named Anna Reynolds, but was interrupted by the intervention of his foes, the vampire hunters Frank Drake and Rachel van Helsing. They chased off Dracula before finding that the woman was okay, and that Dracula did not take enough blood to change her into a vampire. They went after Dracula, and the woman was long be forgotten by her attacker and rescuers. She was brought to a hospital and was diagnosed with severe anemia, however she would eventually recover. She went on with her life and eventually meet Peter McDonald, a computer salesman. The two fell in love, got married, relocated to America, and had a daughter named Jacqueline Louise McDonald. One day while out on Miami Beach with her mother, Jacqueline was attacked by a dog that got loose from its owner, leading to the girl to be hospitalized and require blood transfusions as she was rapidly losing white blood cells in much the same fashion as her mother had when she was attacked by Dracula all those years ago. In some strange twist of fate, the girl was somehow linked to Dracula, who was also greatly weakened and forced to feed on more than his usual number of victims. Believing their daughter to be possessed, the McDonalds sought out priests to perform exorcisms but were refused as the priests they approached didn't believe in possession by the devil. They got the aid of a elderly gypsy medium however who agreed to see their daughter and, although with some resignation from the hospital staff, was allowed to try and cure the girl. At the hospital, the gypsy lit a special candle that revealed that the girl was linked to Dracula, a revelation that did not surprise Anna in the slightest. Just then Dracula appeared in the hospital and began fighting his way to the girl's room. When a security guard attempted to stop him, Dracula forced him to turn the gun and shoot himself in the head. Sensing Dracula's presence coming closer, the force inside Jacqueline erupted with mystical energy, furious that the vampire would come to take back the blood that it had stolen from him. It broke free from its bonds and when Anna tried to go to her child, she was knocked back by the mystical force within the child. The creature within the girl fought off her parents until Dracula arrived and demanded that the creature give back his stolen power. When Anna attempted to separate the creature from her daughter by showing love, the creature proved too strong and Dracula interceded. During the altercation, a sudden flare of energy shot across from young Jacqueline and struck Dracula's brow, knocking him out the window. With Dracula gone, Anne saw that her daughter had been restored to normal.

anna sablinova.name: Anna Sablinova
anna sablinova.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 1
anna sablinova.origin: Anna Sablinova was the daughter of Fritz Sablinov, twin brother and second-in-command to Ernst Sablinova of the Wild Pack, a Symkarian military team that hunted Nazi war criminals. Fritz went missing, working undercover, and later Ernst was believed killed. Ernst's daughter Silvija (who adopted the nickname "Silver Sable") became Anna's sole legal guardian. Silver immediately sent Anna to an American private boarding school, Cranewood School for Girls in Northampton, Long Island, an exclusive (and expensive) place where Anna would have the best possible education, along with the daughters of several important politicians. As it was an all-girls school and teenage Anna would have liked to be around handsome males, she was far from delighted there. The dormitory of the school Anna was at, was taken hostage by Hydra terrorists, led by Silver's former lover Dmitri Petrovich, who demanded the release of dozens of international criminals. In an attempt to force the authorities' hand, Petrovich ordered to execute one of the students, Sarah, while Anna watched helplessly with her other classmates. At that juncture a courageous Anna had the courage to respond to Petrovich, shouting to him that the Hydra was no better than the Hitler's goosestepping Nazi pigs. When Hydra's goons stopped responding due to Silver and her allies confronting them, Anna foresaw that Petrovich would be defeated, and Petrovich answered by taking Anna as his personal hostage, a gun on her head. Sable and her ally Spider-Man burst in, and Anna called Silver "Aunt Silver", thus revealing to Petrovich how valuable she was as a hostage. Still, Petrovich got distracted at a critical moment, and Sable disarmed him by throwing a chai at his armed left hand; Anna then bit Petrovich's right hand with which he was holding her. Spider-Man offered to beat Petrovich up for threatening a small girl, but Sable took care of Petrovich. After humiliatingly defeating Hydra, Silver however refused to show affection to Anna, or to hear her pleas to take her to Symkaria, insisting that Anna was to make the most of the investment Silver was making on her education, at least while Anna was still a minor. A short time later, Anna surprised Silver Sable by going to the Symkarian Embassy in New York City just as Silver was about to go out for a gallant evening with her lover Jacques Girard; Silver's uncle Mortimer received Anna, but Silver insisted that Anna was too young to go away in New York City by night. Left alone at the embassy and crying on the roof, Anna surprised the international thief Black Fox who was sneaking into Symkaria's embassy to rob it. Anna then showed excellent resourcefulness and athletic skills and managed to keep up with the famous thief, using Silver's chai, a magnesium flare and small balls, along with traps and the Embassy's security system, while everyone else was helpless - the Fox had used a narcotic gas to disable the staff, but Anna had been on the roof at that point. In the end, however, the Black Fox eventually got the better of Anna and left her hanging by her feet in the embassy until Silver Sable returned. Silver, who had had a bad night, decided to leave there like that for a while. Sable still refused to let Anna live in Symkaria. Years later, Silver sent Anna to a new, still expensive, school, paying for it with her mercenary activities, though, after a revolution in Symkaria, her status had changed and she no longer could count on the Wild Pack. While investigating a string of murders of criminals in New York City, Silver contacted with Anna via a tablet to ask her to look for connections between four victims. As she had found nothing of notice, Anna on her own expanded the search to also include dozens of recently missing and mysteriously-deceased criminals, and found that NYPD's Rafael Scarfe and his units had investigated every one of them, pointing to Scarfe as a main suspect. This information helped Silver and her allies arrest Scarfe.

fields.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 1
fields.history: Anna Sablinova was the daughter of Fritz Sablinov, twin brother and second-in-command to Ernst Sablinova of the Wild Pack, a Symkarian military team that hunted Nazi war criminals. Fritz went missing, working undercover, and later Ernst was believed killed. Ernst's daughter Silvija (who adopted the nickname "Silver Sable") became Anna's sole legal guardian. Silver immediately sent Anna to an American private boarding school, Cranewood School for Girls in Northampton, Long Island, an exclusive (and expensive) place where Anna would have the best possible education, along with the daughters of several important politicians. As it was an all-girls school and teenage Anna would have liked to be around handsome males, she was far from delighted there. The dormitory of the school Anna was at, was taken hostage by Hydra terrorists, led by Silver's former lover Dmitri Petrovich, who demanded the release of dozens of international criminals. In an attempt to force the authorities' hand, Petrovich ordered to execute one of the students, Sarah, while Anna watched helplessly with her other classmates. At that juncture a courageous Anna had the courage to respond to Petrovich, shouting to him that the Hydra was no better than the Hitler's goosestepping Nazi pigs. When Hydra's goons stopped responding due to Silver and her allies confronting them, Anna foresaw that Petrovich would be defeated, and Petrovich answered by taking Anna as his personal hostage, a gun on her head. Sable and her ally Spider-Man burst in, and Anna called Silver "Aunt Silver", thus revealing to Petrovich how valuable she was as a hostage. Still, Petrovich got distracted at a critical moment, and Sable disarmed him by throwing a chai at his armed left hand; Anna then bit Petrovich's right hand with which he was holding her. Spider-Man offered to beat Petrovich up for threatening a small girl, but Sable took care of Petrovich. After humiliatingly defeating Hydra, Silver however refused to show affection to Anna, or to hear her pleas to take her to Symkaria, insisting that Anna was to make the most of the investment Silver was making on her education, at least while Anna was still a minor. A short time later, Anna surprised Silver Sable by going to the Symkarian Embassy in New York City just as Silver was about to go out for a gallant evening with her lover Jacques Girard; Silver's uncle Mortimer received Anna, but Silver insisted that Anna was too young to go away in New York City by night. Left alone at the embassy and crying on the roof, Anna surprised the international thief Black Fox who was sneaking into Symkaria's embassy to rob it. Anna then showed excellent resourcefulness and athletic skills and managed to keep up with the famous thief, using Silver's chai, a magnesium flare and small balls, along with traps and the Embassy's security system, while everyone else was helpless - the Fox had used a narcotic gas to disable the staff, but Anna had been on the roof at that point. In the end, however, the Black Fox eventually got the better of Anna and left her hanging by her feet in the embassy until Silver Sable returned. Silver, who had had a bad night, decided to leave there like that for a while. Sable still refused to let Anna live in Symkaria. Years later, Silver sent Anna to a new, still expensive, school, paying for it with her mercenary activities, though, after a revolution in Symkaria, her status had changed and she no longer could count on the Wild Pack. While investigating a string of murders of criminals in New York City, Silver contacted with Anna via a tablet to ask her to look for connections between four victims. As she had found nothing of notice, Anna on her own expanded the search to also include dozens of recently missing and mysteriously-deceased criminals, and found that NYPD's Rafael Scarfe and his units had investigated every one of them, pointing to Scarfe as a main suspect. This information helped Silver and her allies arrest Scarfe.
fields.trivia: Although Silver is Anna's cousin, Anna calls her "Aunt Silver", possibly because Silver is her legal guardian. Recently, however, Silver has started asking Anna to not use that nickname. When Silver talked with Anna via a tablet recently, there was an image of a young woman on the screen during their conversation. However, in the previous moments, the screen showed several photographs of people of interest for the investigation, suggesting that Anna was not having a video conference, instead sharing her screen, so the woman on the screen is possibly not Anna.

anna twisdon.name: Anna Twisdon
anna twisdon.origin: thumb|leftAnna Twisdon is the daughter of Lord Twisdon, who one night was kidnapped by the Balus who sought to make her his tribe's "white goddess". After her capture, he hypnotized her into being his loyal slave. Anna's father was colleagues with the detective known as Dakor the Magician, who searched for Anna after her kidnapping. When Dakor fought his way to her, Anna and Balus ordered Dakor to be dipped in the Pool of Nordu, which would could nullify Dakor's magical abilities and then have him tossed into a raging fire. When Dakor was tossed into the fire, the heat evaporated the liquid from the pool, allowing Dakor to use his magic and save himself. Dakor then killed Balus, freeing Anna from his control.

anna watson.name: Anna Watson
anna watson.origin: ===Early Life=== Anna May Watson was born in Phoenixville, Pennsylvania. She had at least three brothers, Philip, Spencer, and Lou. Through Philip, Anna became the aunt of Mary Jane Watson and Gayle Watson-Byrnes, while another niece, Kristy Watson, was born to one of Lou and his wife Sybil. At nineteen, Anna moved to California hoping to become an actress. There she met radio writer Jacob Hilliard. The pair quickly fell in love and married after knowing each other for only a short time. Their marriage subsequently deteriorated, and Anna began an affair with singer Johnny Dipalma. Overcome by guilt, Anna ended the affair, confessed to Jacob, and returned alone to New York. Ashamed of what had happened, she concealed the marriage and affair from those closest to her for decades. Anna was also married to a man named Robert at another point in her life. She eventually settled in Forest Hills, Queens, where she became the neighbor and close friend of May Parker. Mary Jane's childhood was troubled by her father Philip's abusive behavior and the eventual breakup of her parents' marriage. After Mary Jane, her mother, and her sister began moving between relatives, Mary Jane developed a particular affection for Anna. Anna subsequently introduced her niece to May Parker, establishing the connection that would eventually bring Mary Jane and Peter Parker together. ===Friendship with May Parker=== Anna became a regular presence in the Parker household and one of May's closest confidantes. When May's health deteriorated, Anna frequently helped care for her, allowing Peter to continue attending school and handling his other responsibilities. She also accompanied May to Peter's high school graduation, where Anna eagerly anticipated telling Mary Jane about Peter's achievement. When Peter disappeared after being abducted by the Green Goblin, May became increasingly distressed. Anna attempted to reassure her, contacted the Daily Bugle while searching for Peter, and called May's doctor when her friend's condition worsened. Anna continued helping May through subsequent illnesses and emotional crises. Though May turned down Anna's initial offer, the two women eventually ended up sharing a home for a period. Seeking additional income, they rented a room to a boarder who was actually Doctor Octopus, although neither initially realized his identity. When May's health was threatened during one of Mysterio's schemes, Peter again relied upon Anna to remain with her and keep her calm. Another time, Anna even ended a trip to Florida early that she and Mary Jane were taking when she heard May had another health scare. Although Anna shared May's devotion to Peter, she occasionally felt May worried excessively about him and believed Peter was old enough to take greater responsibility for himself and his aunt. ===Peter Parker and Mary Jane=== Long before Peter met Mary Jane, Anna repeatedly spoke highly of her niece to May. Convinced the two young people would be well suited, Anna and May attempted to arrange a meeting between them. Peter repeatedly avoided the proposed introduction. Their efforts eventually succeeded when Peter visited Anna's home and finally met Mary Jane face-to-face. Anna and May were pleased when Peter and Mary Jane immediately took an interest in one another. Anna remained an enthusiastic supporter of the relationship. She occasionally disapproved of Mary Jane's pursuit of modeling, dancing, and acting, preferring to see her niece settle down with Peter. When May was hospitalized after apparently seeing the deceased Gwen Stacy alive, Anna informed Peter of May's condition and of the mysterious woman who had frightened her. The woman was subsequently revealed to be a clone of Gwen. Anna remained connected to both Peter and Mary Jane as their relationship changed over the following years. When Anna herself was hospitalized, she informed Peter that he had narrowly missed seeing Mary Jane. She continued to believe that Peter was a good match for her niece. ===Kidnapping and Marriage=== Anna's connection to Peter eventually placed her directly in danger. Alistaire Smythe kidnapped Anna after mistakenly identifying her as Spider-Man's aunt. Mary Jane attempted to rescue her and deceived Smythe by claiming that she herself was Spider-Man before Peter intervened. Peter and Mary Jane eventually decided to marry. Anna attended their wedding, seeing the relationship she and May had encouraged from the beginning reach its culmination. Their marriage was later erased from history as a result of Peter and Mary Jane's agreement with Mephisto. In the altered history, Peter failed to arrive for the wedding ceremony, leaving Anna furious with him and regretting having introduced him to Mary Jane. Mary Jane ultimately chose not to proceed with the marriage. ===Norman Osborn's Deception=== At the time May Parker suffered a stroke, Anna was staying in Florida. When Mary Jane decided to leave New York temporarily to confront unresolved iss

fields.history: Helped Tony Stark get his armor back, then had an affair with him, then came to work for Stark Industries in the United States.
fields.notes: In the novel of unknown canon status, Iron Man: The Gauntlet, it is revealed that Mandarin tricked Anna into perfecting the technology of Mandarin's Rings on the premise that she would be working for S.H.I.E.L.D. on her psionic control project. After completing her given task, Mandarin then tried to convince her to crack the Iron Man Armor's system, but this time, she refused. With Mandarin deciding that she was of no use to him anymore, he assassinated her and framed it as suicide. Years later, he revealed the true circumstances regarding her death to Tony Stark, which enraged Tony.

annabella gorrini.name: Annabella Gorrini
annabella gorrini.origin: After killing a couple who were using their children to make child pornography, Frank Castle became involved in a plot to kill him, orchestrated by Annabella Gorrini, a granddaughter of Don Massimo Cesare whom Castle had killed some years earlier along with most of Annabella's male family members. Annabella had gathered a group, the Five Wives all of whom were mob widows thanks to the actions of Castle and who planned to lure Castle in and kill him. Like all others, she was taken out by Jennifer Cesare.

annabelle adams.name: Annabelle Adams
annabelle adams.origin: Annabelle Adams was a bartender and singer at the Four Seasons Hotel in Houston, where the fugitive Kaine had taken up residence. After long nights, Kaine often visited the bar, where Annabelle was immediately drawn to the mysterious man, though he largely ignored her flirtations. Through Kaine's involvement with Aracely Peña, a young girl he rescued from human traffickers and later brought to the hotel, Annabelle was asked to help translate, as she spoke Spanish. During Aracely's recovery, she and Annabelle formed a close friendship. Annabelle comforted the girl during the emergence of her strange psychic powers and prophetic dreams, even being present during one of her episodes. While watching a news report one evening, Aracely accidentally revealed that Kaine was the Scarlet Spider, shocking Annabelle. As part of Kaine's new supporting circle in Houston, Annabelle became one of several recurring allies including Aracely, Dr. Donald Meland, and Officer Wally Layton, who grounded the fugitive hero in a makeshift family. She frequently served as a moral anchor, helping to temper his violent impulses and offering him a glimpse of the life he longed for but struggled to maintain. left|200px|thumb Annabelle continued to cross paths with Kaine's dangerous double life. While she was performing in a church concert with her band, Ana Kravinoff tracked Kaine there and set the building ablaze during their fight, forcing Annabelle and the crowd to flee. Despite being caught in the chaos of his vigilante career, including his battle with Carnage during the Minimum Carnage event, she gradually grew closer to Kaine, often softening his violent impulses and giving him perspective. Annabelle's connection to Kaine deepened when she was taken hostage during a robbery by men dressed as Santa Claus at the Four Seasons Hotel. After convincing the robbers to bring her to Kaine's room, she was saved when he donned his Scarlet Spider costume and defeated them. She later aided Kaine and Aracely during their investigations into human trafficking in Houston. right|300px|thumb|Annabelle at the Rodeo Over time, Annabelle developed romantic feelings for Kaine. The two shared their first kiss at a rodeo, beginning a brief relationship. However, Annabelle's emotions sometimes clouded her judgment, most notably when she burned a letter from Julia Carpenter that warned Kaine to leave Houston. left|thumb|200px|Annabelle burns Julia Carpenter (Earth-616)|Madame Web's letter Her involvement with Kaine and his allies soon turned deadly. During a night out together, she, Aracely, Meland, and Layton were kidnapped by Kraven the Hunter and his daughter Ana. To secure their release, Kaine was forced into a brutal confrontation with Kraven, who demanded to be slain to end his curse of resurrection. When Kaine refused, Ana mortally wounded Donald. In the violent clash that followed, Kaine drove his stinger through Kraven’s heart, killing him, only to revive him moments later. The sheer savagery of the encounter, and Kaine’s cold willingness to kill, left Annabelle horrified. Not long afterward, Annabelle was targeted during Kaine's conflict with the wasp-goddess Shathra. The totemic predator assumed Annabelle's form to torment Kaine, exploiting his feelings for her, mocking his hopes of redemption, and luring him into battle. When Kaine succumbed to his monstrous transformation into the Other, Annabelle was forced to confront the horrifying sight of the man she loved twisting into a hulking arachnid predator. Terrified and heartbroken, she fled from him. In the aftermath of Shathra's destruction, Kaine abandoned Houston altogether, leaving behind Annabelle and the life he had briefly tried to build.

After convincing the robbers to bring her to Kaine's room, she was saved when he donned his Scarlet Spider costume and defeated them. She later aided Kaine and Aracely during their investigations into human trafficking in Houston. right|300px|thumb|Annabelle at the Rodeo Over time, Annabelle developed romantic feelings for Kaine. The two shared their first kiss at a rodeo, beginning a brief relationship. However, Annabelle's emotions sometimes clouded her judgment, most notably when she burned a letter from Julia Carpenter that warned Kaine to leave Houston. left|thumb|200px|Annabelle burns Julia Carpenter (Earth-616)|Madame Web's letter Her involvement with Kaine and his allies soon turned deadly. During a night out together, she, Aracely, Meland, and Layton were kidnapped by Kraven the Hunter and his daughter Ana. To secure their release, Kaine was forced into a brutal confrontation with Kraven, who demanded to be slain to end his curse of resurrection. When Kaine refused, Ana mortally wounded Donald. In the violent clash that followed, Kaine drove his stinger through Kraven’s heart, killing him, only to revive him moments later. The sheer savagery of the encounter, and Kaine’s cold willingness to kill, left Annabelle horrified. Not long afterward, Annabelle was targeted during Kaine's conflict with the wasp-goddess Shathra. The totemic predator assumed Annabelle's form to torment Kaine, exploiting his feelings for her, mocking his hopes of redemption, and luring him into battle. When Kaine succumbed to his monstrous transformation into the Other, Annabelle was forced to confront the horrifying sight of the man she loved twisting into a hulking arachnid predator. Terrified and heartbroken, she fled from him. In the aftermath of Shathra's destruction, Kaine abandoned Houston altogether, leaving behind Annabelle and the life he had briefly tried to build.

annabelle riggs.name: Annabelle Riggs
annabelle riggs.origin: Dr. Annabelle Riggs decided to become an archaeologist inspired by the Indiana Jones movies she watched growing up. She knew Misty Knight for some time and the museum that she worked for kept her on retainer. She hired Misty to acquire various artifacts, one of them being an Asgardian statuette. Misty took the statuette to a Viking mass grave where Annabelle was working on an excavation. Annabell accidentally activated the figurine, and it emitted a melody that awakened the Viking corpses. The Asgardian Valkyrie was drawn by the song, arrived and aided Misty in fending of the undead horde. When Valkyrie noticed the statue, she had the doctor hand it over upon which Valkyrie destroyed the statue, much to the archaeologist's dismay. In exchange for destroying the statue, Dr. Riggs insisted that Valkyrie took her with her on her mission. The Asgardian initially rejected this out of concern for the human's well-being, but Annabelle stood her ground and so, Valkyrie reluctantly agreed to allow both Annabelle and Misty Knight to accompany her. When Valkyrie and the Valkyrior confronted Caroline Le Fay in an attempt to stop her from using Dani Moonstar to revive the Doom Maidens, it was revealed that Brunnhilde used to be one of them. Brunnhilde used the ruins to siphon power from Moonstar, and was transformed into the Doom Maiden of Rage. She destroyed the Doom Maidens, and then defeated all the other heroes as well. Annabelle was able to stop her, but was killed in the process. Valkyrie felt intense grief over Annabelle's death and returned her to life with the help of Clea. However, Valkyrie became Annabelle's anchor to the land of the living, and the two shared a body, being able to switch back and forth between the two. Anticipating the culmination of the War of the Realms waged by Malekith the Accursed, Kid Loki assembled a group of Asgard's allies, the Asgardians of the Galaxy, with the intention to retrieve the Naglfar Beacon. Annabelle was part of this team, together with her other half, the Valkyrie. During their quest, Loki magically limited Annabelle's ability to channel Valkyrie to help prove her worth in combat. He also provided her with a magically-hacked Nova Corps helmet to fight on her own. After acquiring the Naglfar Beacon from Nebula, the Asgardians of the Galaxy became embroiled in defending Manhattan from Malekith's assault, and Valkyrie died at the hands of Malekith. Since Valkyrie and Annabelle were two separate entities, whenever Brunnhilde took her place, Annabelle was sent to rest in a pocket dimension in the boundaries of Valhalla. Annabelle and Brunnhilde co-existed in this plane for a few moments before her death, and they bid farewell. With Valkyrie's death, this pocket dimension collapsed, leaving Annabelle to become lost in the mists that surround Valhalla. Clea approached Annabelle's girlfriend Ren Kimura to use her connection to track Annabelle, and they were joined by some of her fellow Asgardians of the Galaxy. The rescue mission was successful, and Annabelle returned to the land of the living. Annabelle continued fighting with the Asgardians of the Galaxy to defend the Earth until it was liberated.

annabelle st john.name: Annabelle St. John
annabelle st john.origin: In September 1862, Dracula lord of the Vampires traveled to Savannah, Georgia. Dracula agreed to bolster the Confederacy with his Vampiric Legion of the Damned in exchange for Annabelle St. John's return to Transylvania. Though the Legion slaughtered all Union troops they came across, Anabelle's father recognized Dracula for what he was, and along with his son Cornelius staked him. Anabelle, determined to honor the bargain, removed the stake and returned home with him.

annalee.name: Annalee
annalee.origin: ===Early Life=== Annalee was a mutant who lived beneath Manhattan as a member of the Morlocks, specifically among the group known as the Drain Dwellers. She was the mother of four mutant children, but little is known of their lives before joining the Morlock community. While the children were away from the tunnels, they were shot and killed on the surface. Their bodies were recovered by the Morlocks and brought back to the Alley. The identity of their murderer was not known at the time, although it was later revealed to have been Scalphunter. The loss devastated Annalee. Her grief was intensified by her mutant ability to project her own emotions into those around her, causing the other Morlocks to experience her overwhelming sorrow. To prevent Annalee's despair from continually affecting the community, Callisto ordered Leech to remain close to her so that his mutant-negating powers would suppress her abilities. Annalee resented Leech and did not initially regard him as a replacement for her children, while Leech nevertheless longed for Annalee to become his mother. ===Power Pack=== left|thumb The Drain Dwellers eventually became frustrated that Leech's presence also neutralized their own powers. After learning of the young heroes known as the Power Pack, they decided to give the four children to Annalee as replacements for those she had lost. The Power siblings were captured in the Morlock tunnels and brought before Annalee, who eagerly accepted the prospect of having children again. The Morlocks intended for Beautiful Dreamer to alter the children's memories while Masque reshaped their appearances so that they would forget their former lives and believe themselves to be Annalee's children. Power Pack resisted the plan, and when Leech was drawn away from them, they regained access to their abilities. Annalee's distress during the resulting struggle caused her to radiate such intense misery that it began affecting virtually everyone around her. Shadowcat and Nightcrawler, who had come to the Morlock tunnels, assisted Power Pack in escaping. Despite the failure of the abduction, Annalee remained fixated on the children and later secretly watched the Power family home, still intending to make them hers. Annalee and her fellow Morlocks subsequently made another attempt to take Power Pack. Masque altered the children's appearances and Beautiful Dreamer manipulated their memories, while the Powers' parents were made to forget their children. Katie Power escaped before her memories could be completely altered and eventually came to the attention of the X-Men, who accompanied her back into the tunnels. After the X-Men confronted the Morlocks, Callisto intervened and ordered that the Power children be restored to normal. Although Callisto sympathized with Annalee's grief and promised that the Morlocks would seek justice for the murder of her children, she made it clear that Power Pack was henceforth off-limits. Despondent, Annalee challenged Callisto to kill her so that she could be reunited with her children. Katie instead comforted her. Annalee recalled that her youngest child had been very quiet and possessed a gift similar to that of the Healer, saying that merely being near the girl made others feel better. Katie told Annalee that taking the Power children would only inflict the same grief upon their own parents and proposed that, rather than trying to become their mother, Annalee could become their "special grandmother." Annalee accepted Katie's offer. ===Leech=== Despite her developing friendship with Power Pack, Annalee initially continued to reject Leech. When Katie invited several of her friends and acquaintances to the Power family's Thanksgiving celebration, Annalee planned to attend but refused to allow Leech to accompany her. She locked him away and treated him harshly, telling him that she no longer needed him to suppress her emotional projections because she intended to radiate happiness rather than grief. Leech escaped and followed Annalee into the city. When she angrily rejected him again, her emotions spread to the surrounding crowd and contributed to chaos during the Thanksgiving parade. Alex Power, Cloak, and Dagger eventually intervened. Alex confronted Annalee over her treatment of Leech, while Leech continued to insist that he wanted Annalee to be his mother despite her cruelty toward him. His affection finally broke through Annalee's resentment. Realizing how badly she had treated him, Annalee embraced Leech and accepted his love. The two attended the Thanksgiving gathering together and subsequently departed hand in hand, with Annalee finally treating Leech as her foster son. ===Mutant Massacre and Death=== Annalee later took three additional young Morlocks into her care. During the Mutant Massacre, the Marauders invaded the Morlock tunnels and slaughtered their inhabitants. Annalee attempted to hide with the three children but was discovered by Scalphunter. She pleaded with him to spare the

anne avery.name: Anne Avery
anne avery.origin: Anne and her new husband, John, spent their honeymoon in the Egyptian desert. Here, they discovered a giant egg and left exposed to the sun while they went to seek help in transporting it. In their absence the Roc hatched and began to terrorize the world. John eventually realized it needed a mate and so was able to convince the world to build a giant robot Roc and fly it into space, causing the actual Roc to follow it and leave the earth behind. The pair continued on their honeymoon.

anne benson.origin: Nothing has been revealed about the past of Anne Benson. As a young woman, Benson worked as a technician at an unnamed laboratory. She casually dated one of the scientists who worked at the lab, a short-statured man named Howard Lindley. Howard was in love with Anne, but was too self-conscious to admit his true feelings to her, and convinced himself that Anne only went out with him out of pity. After years of being ridiculed for his stature, Howard was day-dreaming about being strong and tough like Bruttu, a large monster in one of his comic books, thinking that being so strong would help to impress Anne. Howard accidently activated a new machine in the lab, and was exposed to atomic rays, and was transformed into Bruttu, and ended up destroying the lab with his new body. After being attcked for his menacing appearance, Howard attempted to see Anne one last time. When he found her, Anne was terrified, and came to the conclusion that the monster had killed "the man she loved," believing that the monster had killed Howard in the lab. Realizing that Anne had loved him all along, Howard returned to the lab and changed himself back into a human. When Anne found Howard alive, she embraced him, and lived happily ever after.

anne bronson.name: Anne Bronson
anne bronson.origin: Anne Benson was a married mother of one. When her ex-Marine husband, Steve, decided that their son, Bobby, was a sissy for being more interested in books than sports, Anne protested that he was no different from any other child. However, Steve decided that the boy should be toughened up, and announced that he was taking Bobby on a trip to Mexico to "rough it" for a few weeks. Wanting to keep an eye on Bobby, Anne chose to tag along. While hiking up a mountain with her family, Steve found an empty cave and decided to explore. Finding an iron door in the cave, Steve blew the door off its hinges with explosive powder, only to awaken the alien creature inside known as The Sandman. Anne and Bobby ran while Steve held the creature off, but it overpowered Steve and forced the family to smuggle it into the United States. After making it back to the city, Anne and her family were forced to walk thru the streets with The Sandman while it observed the people. Steve alerted the military to the creature's presence during a parade, but none of the military's weaponry had any effect on the alien. As the creature escaped the city, Anne noticed Bobby had disappeared and alerted Steve. The boy soon returned with The Sandman trapped in a box and explained that he threw water on the creature, which caused it to become immobile. Anne and her family then returned to their lives, and The Sandman was locked away in a secret military base.

anne carter.name: Anne Carter
anne carter.origin: Bill Carter enters an antique shop looking for a birthday gift for his wife, Anne, and finds an antique mirror. Although the antique dealer warns him that the mirror belonged to a sorcerer and is thought to be enchanted, Bill gets it for his wife, thinking the strange story will enhance the mirror's appeal. Anne puts the mirror in the bedroom, intending to dress in front of it on a daily basis. While initially delighted with the "gorgeous" mirror, Anne soon commented that she sensed evil within the mirror. She dismissed this feeling, blaming it on her overactive imagination. At a later point, Bill found Anne staring at the mirror for over an hour, as if she was mesmerized. The sound of his voice ended her trance, and Anne figured that she must have been daydreaming. Over the following days, Anne spend increasing amounts of time staring into the mirror. Bill was concerned for her, and suggested that she should join him in a walk away from their home. Anne rudely told him to shut up, and was seemingly angered because Bill dared to give her instructions. As time went on, Anne changed. From being typically warm and cheerful, she became sullen and brooding. Bill could not explain what was happening to his wife. A month after receiving the mirror, Anne seemingly received someone's commands through the mirror. She started practicing magical rituals, reciting magical incantations, and performing fantastic rites of ancient magic. Her incantations mentioned the webs of Spiders and the teeth of Snakes. On a certain night, at midnight, an image of an unnamed "black magician" appeared in the mirror. Anne recognized him as her master, who held her in his spell. Anne's summoning rituals apparently worked. The magician wanted Anne to help him return to Earth. But he instructed her first to render Bill harmless, to prevent him from interfering with their plans. Anne called Bill, and claimed to have seen an animal crawling into one their house's rooms. Bill entered the room to investigate, and Anne locked the door behind him. Bill was trapped. Anne explained what happened to the magician. Her "master" next had her working on a resurrection incantation, which would bring him back to life. Anne called on the "dark and foreboding" Spirits to release the magician, and the magician started exiting the mirror. Within the next room, Bill had started pounding on the wall, and calling on the name of Heaven to be released. The vibrations from the pounding knocked the mirror from the wall. The mirror broke, the magician vanished, and Anne was released from his influence. She unlocked the door and released Bill. Afterwards, Anne remembered nothing from her career as a witch. But she noticed the broken mirror, and worried about suffering seven years of bad luck. Bill started laughing uncontrollably, until Anne kissed him.

anne carwell.name: Anne Carwell
anne carwell.origin: Anne Carwell was a member of the Carwell family who took part in a séance organized by Cynthia Nicolson in order to contact the spirit of her deceased husband, David Carwell. During the séance, the proceedings were disrupted when Arnold Nicolson became possessed and transformed into a being calling himself Armak. In the chaos that followed, Anne was seized and carried away by the transformed Arnold, who forcibly broke through the building’s wall and fled. She was later recovered during a confrontation involving Thor and Hercules, and provided an account of the events leading to her abduction.

anne garthwaite.name: Anne Garthwaite
anne garthwaite.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 125
anne garthwaite.origin: Anne Garthwaite is the ex-wife of Burt Garthwaite, and mother of Dirk Garthwaite, the Wrecker. She was severely abused and beaten by her ex-husband. When her son Dirk was four years old, she was led to believe that Burt was dead. Dirk, over the years, sent her tens of thousands of dollars to try and help her, but she refused to cash any of the money orders because it was money taken from crimes. She died still loving her son, but hates what he did, blaming herself for working too hard while it was just her and her son, and not being there for him when he was growing up.
