anti venom ii symbiote.species: Symbiotes Clone reborn as a symbiote-dragon
anti venom ii symbiote.first_appearance: Amazing Spider-Man: Venom Inc. Alpha Vol 1 1
anti venom ii symbiote.origin: Suspecting that the Venom symbiote would develop an immunity to the medication he had developed for its toxic shock syndrome, Alchemax astrobiologist Dr. Steve began creating a new cure derived from the Anti-Venom symbiote. Desiring to reclaim the symbiote and become Agent Venom again, Flash Thompson confronted its host, Eddie Brock, at Alchemax's astrobiology lab. Conflicted over having to choose one of its two favorite hosts over the other, Venom attempted to bond to both of them at the same time. Spider-Man intervened intending to kill the symbiote and "save" both Flash and Eddie from it, overturning one of the vats of Anti-Venom serum. Flash was doused in it, and the symbiote biomass bonded to him was altered into an artificial replica of the original Anti-Venom symbiote. When Lee Price stole Andi Benton's symbiote to become Maniac and began assembling an army of symbiote-controlled criminals, Flash used the newly created Anti-Venom to cut off Maniac's mind control over the Inklings. Using antibodies developed by those who'd been freed from Price's control, Flash then weakened Price's symbiote with the help of Spider-Man, Venom, and Black Cat. When it became known that the Poisons were using symbiotes to attack superheroes, Alchemax called in a favor to Flash to use the properties of his symbiote's antibodies. This turned out to be lethal to the consumed heroes leaving only a puddle with no sign of a human host inside. Although he likewise used them against consumed heroes, the Poisons perished after the Poison Queen was destroyed. When Norman Osborn used the Carnage symbiote to become the "Red Goblin" and kill Spider-Man's relatives, Flash was forced to use the Anti-Venom symbiote to heal their allies, leaving it weakened and unable to fully heal Flash in battle. When Agent Anti-Venom confronted the Red Goblin, it barely had any effect on him and Norman took this opportunity to kill Flash in cold blood, and his Anti-Venom symbiote along with him. left|thumb|Meeting with Flash in Codex Purgatory Using samples of Agent Anti-Venom's symbiote, Dr. Steven was able to produce more Anti-Venom serum. Inspired by the second Anti-Venom symbiote's creation, Dr. Steven created mass-produced Anti-Venom battlesuits by mixing samples of Weapon V's Sym-Suits - cloned offshoots of the Grendel symbiote-dragon that had been lobotomized and severed from the Symbiote Hive-Mind to prevent them from taking over their hosts - with the Anti-Venom serum. After its death, the symbiote joined Flash in the Klyntar's Hive-Mind, where his consciousness was stored as a codex after his death. Together, they joined Rex Strickland's army of former symbiote hosts to battle the dark elder symbiote god Knull. Flash Thompson's codex was able to free the trapped symbiotes and join them by re-emerging in the real world as a white dragon-symbiote. It is unclear what happened to the Anti-Venom symbiote in the Hive-Mind. Although it can be presumed that it was resurrected and is now part of the new Anti-Venom symbiote. The Anti-Venom serum created from it was used in the creation of the Silence, an Anti-Venom symbiote strain, and Misery symbiotes. ==Iterations and Offshoots== Silence - Following the death of the Scream symbiote, Dr. Steven harvested samples obtained from the skin and blood of its host, Andi Benton. When his efforts to revitalize the Scream symbiote proved unsuccessful, Dr. Steven spliced its remains with a sample of Anti-Venom, creating a new symbiote. Misery - A symbiote created by Steven from the fusion between the Anti-Venom and Carnage symbiotes, which later bonded to Alchemax's CEO Liz Allan.

antibody.name: Antibody
antibody.species: Antibody was created from the anti-bodies of UnEarth to be an exact copy of and destroy Minion.
antibody.origin: When Minion ended up on UnEarth, the voodoo doll of Earth created by Mys-Tech and somehow disrupted their testing. Though they could not see the cause, they knew the UnEarth having become partly sentient would handle it. The UnEarth seeing Minion as a harmful virus created the Antibody, a being that is an exact copy of the threat to the UnEarth. It attacked Minion and though Antibody was physically equal to Minion, it lacked in intelligence but as they fought it learned. After losing to Minion Antibody began access the memories of the one it was copied from, vowing to one day destroy Minion it teleported away abandoning UnEarth.

antibrote.name: Antibrotè
antibrote.origin: Antibrotè was one of the Amazons living in Themiscyra, on the Thermodon River, in Anatolia. Along with eleven other fellow Amazons Clonié, Polemusa, Evandrè, Antandrè, Bremusa, Hippothoè, Harmothoè, Alcibiè, Derimacheia, Derinoè and Thermodosa, Clonié accompanied Penthesilea who went to Troy in the last years of the Trojan War in order to cleanse her soul after the accidental murder of her sister and queen Hippolyta. The Amazons were acclaimed by the crowd and welcomed by King Priam and his family. There, Penthesilea swore that she and her Amazons would kill Achilles and repel the Argives back to their coasts, despite the accusation of arrogance from Andromache, widow of Hector whom Achilles had slain. The next day, they went to battle as the vanguard of the Trojans who were galvanized by Penthesilea. Priam prayed for help to Zeus, but saw an eagle grasping a dove and interpreted it as the fact Penthesileia would not return alive. Thersites alarmed the Argives, and they met the Trojans in the battlefield. There, Antibrotè was killed along all her sword-sisters. Witnessing the death of her Amazons, Penthesilea entered a fury, and was herself eventually killed by Achilles. Antibrotè and the other Amazons were buried beside Penthesilea.

antigone.name: Antigone
antigone.origin: ===Origin=== Antigone was a Synthezoid created by Alkhema at Robotopia, Al-Luxor, Egypt. She was created in a batch of Bio-Synthezoids. It was later revealed that the Synthezoid creation was part of Ultron's plans to create an army, hidden in Alkhema's programming. The Avengers destroyed the base, believing all the Synthezoids had been killed. Antigone survived, carrying Ultron's head, hiding until the Avengers had left. Ultron ordered her to rebuild him, but due to her childlike nature she kicked his head like a ball, exclaiming that she wanted to see the world. ===Sons of Yinsen=== Antigone finally brought Ultron's head to a former sentient Iron Man Armor, posing as the reborn Ho Yinsen, and took over the Sons of Yinsen. She stayed with Ultron until he battled Iron Man. Stark was able to download Jocasta's mind into Ultron, creating enough of a distraction to destroy him. Ultron's head flew into the sky with Antigone, crashing into the ground. Her body survived, now hosting Jocasta's consciousness, it was taken to a Las Vegas hospital.

antilochus.origin: Antilochus was the son of Nestor and a bosom friend to Achilles. He had a brother, Pisistratus. During the Trojan War, he was killed by the dark Aethiopian warrior-king Memnon, and was avenged by Achilles. He first emerged in Earth Orbit near Alpha Flight's Low-Orbit Space Station, and after briefly orienting himself, he almost immediately began attacking Singularity. He followed her from New York City to Japan to Florida, before finally facing off in the Blue Area of the Moon, where Antimatter battled against A-Force. Antimatter was seemingly destroyed, but his particles dispersed across the Earth, infecting multiple individuals. His apparent death also brought forth other interdimensional travelers such as Dazzler Thor and the Countess.

fields.notes: In an attempt to tell the story of Chanukah to a dissipated Aleph class, Doc Samson had to describe Antiochus IV as an Ultron-like evil robot, the fourth of his kind (hence the name). He possibly had hordes of demons from the pits of Hell, presented as "ugly creatures, called from the pits of Heck", but that could only a lie to have him look like Shredder on TV. Samson's story also mentions Antiochus attacking Santa Claus, but is unknown if it is true or not.

antiphon.name: Antiphon
antiphon.origin: ===Origin=== Antiphon the Overseer was one of the first beings (possibly even the first) known as the Proemial Gods. His purpose was to monitor the Cosmic Consonance, and he was tasked to only watch, but was forbidden to act. The form fitting the function, he was therefore the weakest of his kind, with the most vulnerable form. ===The Proemial Gods' Civil War=== When war erupted between the Proemial Gods, caused by Diableri of Chaos and followed by many of the Proemial Gods (and especially by Tenebrous of the Darkness Between and Aegis, Lady of All Sorrows), Antiphon - true to his purpose - was the only one that remained neutral and uninvolved in the entire conflict and rejected all of Diableri's ambitions. The conflict caused many casualties among the Proemial Gods, and was eventually brought to Galactus, who killed Diableri and imprisoned Aegis and Tenebrous in the Kyln. ===Imprisonment and Death=== Antiphon was imprisoned along with his surviving kin in the Kyln for unknown reasons and died there under equally unknown circumstances. It was suggested between Tenebrous and Aegis, after returning to the Kyln and finding Antiphon's corpse, that their fellow god came to resent being diminished and this was why he was imprisoned; however, this is just speculation.

fields.notes: Antiphon strongly resembles the Watchers and even has the same function: to watch but not act. It is not clear when, why, or how Antiphon became trapped in the Kyln. Galactus, who had trapped Tenebrous and Aegis, did not mention Antiphon in his account to the Silver Surfer.
fields.trivia: Antiphon's name is also a noun, meaning a response to a psalm or some other part of a religious service, such as at Vespers or at a Mass. This meaning gave rise to the word "antiphony", a call and response style of singing.

antiphonus.name: Antiphonus
antiphonus.origin: Antiphonus was one of the many sons of King Priam of Troy. He fought for his city during the Trojan War, after his brother Paris had stolen Helen from her husband Menelaus, king of Sparta. When the Argives eventually entered the city at the tenth year of the war, Menelaus led Diomedes and Achilles' son Neoptolemus to Priam's throne room. Priam had deserted it, but Neoptolemus found there his sons Pammon, Polites, and Antiphonus, which he all slew in instants.

antiquary.name: Antiquary
antiquary.origin: The Antiquary was a prominent member of the New Orleans Thieves Guild. Acting outside the remit of the various families who controlled the guild, he formed his own power base, the "Antiquary clan" or the "velvet ministry", by stealing abandoned children and raising them to do his bidding. He called the practice "collecting", but the children were slaves, to be used or sold on. Some of the children would grow up in his remit, and become his underlings, serving his great passion - collating information on the "old kingdom", which was the legendary original home of the Thieves Guild. Though some of the guild found his actions repugnant, the profit of his trade had earned him connections to the outside world which made him difficult to move against. As such, he was given portions of the guild's elixir of immortality, which allowed him a long life, to meet various magicians from history. Several decades ago, under unknown circumstances, the Antiquary found a baby with red eyes. Connecting the baby to the guild legend of the "Diable Blanc" (a white man with red eyes who was prophesied to unite the guilds), he decided he would not sell the baby, but would instead raise them. However, he was gainsaid by the guild patriarch Jean-Luc LeBeau, who took the child out of his power and arranged for him to be raised by others. Also, under unspecified circumstances, Jean-Luc LeBeau ordered the excommunication of the Antiquary, after which he moved to a mansion in Moscow, where he continued his research into the "old kingdom". With the exit of the Antiquary, his clan was managed by his former students, Tome (the librarian of the guilds archives) and Hoard (the guild's accountant).

antjie qoboza.name: Antjie Qoboza
antjie qoboza.origin: Activated as a mutant pyrokinetic following the dispersion of the Phoenix Force, crusading human rights attorney and peace activist Antjie Qoboza decided to host a panel, "Moderating the Murder: A Debate on Arms Regulation," at the Security and Defense Symposium, an arms industry convention, in Alexandria, Egypt. Knowing full well the vast majority of the attendees despised her, to the point that she was asked to leave multiple times before her panel even began, Qoboza demonstrated her powers in full view of her audience to make plain that she was more than capable of defending herself from their aggression. Suddenly, she received a mysterious signal through her earpiece that caused her powers to rage out of control, ultimately erupting into a massive conflagration that incinerated the entire convention hall and almost all of the 3000 people therein, including herself. Nathan and Hope Summers were the sole survivors. "The Alexandria Incident" became an enormous public relations disaster for the mutant community, while creating sympathy for the arms industry by casting them as victims of mutant terrorism. Unbeknownst to all involved at the time, this was exactly as intended by the true architect of the tragedy, Russian weapons baron Yevgeny Volga, who had used his slave, the power-amplifying mutant MeMe, to send the fatal signal to Qoboza.

antoine delsoin.name: Antoine Delsoin
antoine delsoin.first_appearance: Peter Parker, The Spectacular Spider-Man Vol 1 24
antoine delsoin.origin: Antoine Delsoin was the lead singer of the "Mercy Killers" under the stage name "Hypno-Hustler". Antoine Delsoin was performing at the nightclub called Beyond Forever with his band, when he is caught by the club owner stealing from the safe. Antoine uses his equipment to hypnotize the manager. The band then decided to hypnotize the audience at their next gig into giving him their valuables and money. Peter Parker was at the club with friends Harry Osborn, Liz Allan, Holly Gillis, Betty Brant, Flash Thompson, and his girlfriend Sha Shan. He saw what was happening so rushed to change into his Spider-Man costume. Whilst fighting the band, he discovers that Hypno-Hustler's headphones protected him from his own hypnotic music. Spider-Man removes Hypno-Hustler's headphones, causing him to become hypnotized along with everyone else. When the audience was free of the hypnosis, Spider-Man leaves the Hypno-Hustler and his band in webbed up for the police to find. Antoine Delsoin was later asked to take part in the Vil-Anon (Villains Anonymous) meeting with Schizoid Man, Armadillo, Big Wheel, Man-Bull, and Equinox. He was one of the many villains who attempted to capture Lily Hollister's, aka Menace, baby Stanley Osborn for Doctor Octopus. He tried to run and enter a police station, wanting to escape Spider-Man on a rampage against criminals, believing the baby was dead, having already taken down Diablo, the Spot, and Overdrive. He was later seen hiring Deadpool and the Tinkerer, who upgraded Hypno-Hustler's hypno tech goggles.

antoine moray.name: Antoine Moray
antoine moray.origin: He and Luke were out of jail and after Moray got out he started being known as Babalao and scamming people claiming he was a powerful voodoo healer. He was in a voodoo session with a woman named Denise who he managed to con and Denise backed out. Antoine and Luke talked about Denise's scam and also talked about Dr. Renee Dubois getting clients from them. Luke went to look at the Dubois clinic and went to tell Babalao that if something wasn't done with her the business would collapse. Rene was kidnapped and Babalao applied a muscle paralyzer so that people would see her and believe in Babalao again. At night I put together a ritual where I assure Renee that she was cursed and that she would use her powers to save her. David Banner interrupted the ritual by demanding that Babalao show him his powers. Two men took David out of the room and Babalao asked Selene to take Renee's life. Hulk arrived, stopped Babalao and the fake healer was later arrested.

antoinette turner.name: Antoinette Turner
antoinette turner.origin: After working as a model for years, Toni eventually married Burt Chesney, despite some last-minute worries on the day of the ceremony. In modern day, Toni continued to work with Millie. While modelling for Hanover and taking part in photoshoots alongside Millie, Patsy Walker, Chili Storm, and Jill Jerold. Millie was briefly imprisoned after finding a gun by a shot photographer, Toni helped to clear Millie's name and to investigate the crime while also being targeted by thugs, which turned out to be the work of Sachet Nelson, the photographer's ex-girlfriend. When Hawkeye was investigating the murder of Tuli Guzman, a lead led him to Millie and Toni's agency. Toni put Clint in contact with Melanie, who was an associate of Tuli's missing sister, Marcia.

anton aubuisson.name: Anton Aubuisson
anton aubuisson.origin: Despite protest from Endo, Rhodey left the satellite to face Anton Aubuisson, a corrupt former French Special Forces soldier who represented the Roxxon Energy Corporation in negotiations with the Anunquit tribe in western Canada. While his presence was legally sanctioned, Aubuisson killed the Anunquit representatives that refused Roxxon's construction of a oil pipeline on their land using polar bears enhanced with Sakaarian control disks and exoskeleton upgrades via Ultimo technology from Eaglestar International, a corrupt paramilitary defense contracting firm. Rhodey destroyed the pipeline and the bears killed Aubuisson after Rhodey destroyed his Sakaarian control staff.

anton bigelow.name: Anton Bigelow
anton bigelow.origin: Anton Bigelow was a drug dealer who had been very upset when the Punisher blew up his ship, which carried 20 million dollars worth of heroin. Suspecting an attack by a rival organization, Bigelow took some men down to Hampden to throw around some of his gang's muscle. However, he was attacked by Bosephus and made an escaped when the car blew up under Bosephus. He also made no effort to save his bimbo, who was left stuck in the car. Later on, Bigelow was hired by the Wizard, who recommended that rather than trying another assault, he strike at the Family by taking out their financial power base. Wizard offered to create a PCP variant, with fewer side effects, that could put the Family out of business. Once he received the package, Bigelow took three of the PCP variants to try them out, and then found out that he only should have taken 1/2 of one. His agents barricaded him in his room, and he began howling savagely and beating on the door. When Bosephus arrived, Bigelow broke out and attacked him. That was when the Punisher arrived, wearing his exo-armor to stand up to the superhuman powerhouses, and Bosephus ended up going out the window. Bigelow battered the Punisher's armor, disabling it, and hurled him down the stairs. However, before Bigelow could leap down to finish off the Punisher, he found that his shoulder gun was still functioning. Castle pumped him chock full of bullets and left him for dead.

anton decibel.name: Anton Decibel
anton decibel.origin: Little is known about Doctor Decibel's life before his appearance as one of the members of the criminal Institute of Evil. At one point, he operated on the vocal cords of Lady Lark (aka Linda Lewis), a former pop singer, giving her superhuman powers. He often clashed with the heroes of the Squadron Supreme, to which Lewis belonged. During its "Utopia Program" the Squadron Supreme brainwashed Decibel using a mind-altering device, after which he joined the Squadron. Decibel attended Squadron member Quagmire, who fell into a coma after saving innocents from a fire. Quagmire's extradimensional ooze manifested uncontrollably, filling all the space near him, including the whole hospital. The Darkforce ooze enveloped and suffocated Doctor Decibel.

anton delionatus.name: Anton DeLionatus
anton delionatus.origin: Someone vowing revenge against the production of the film Spawn of the Spider hires three crooks (Strongman, Tumbler, and Acrobat) to put on new spider-themed costumes and attack the production as the Spider-Squad. Sure enough, the Spider-Squad attacks the set, and get locked in battle with Spider-Man. They manage to get away when they tag Spider-Man with a temporary poison and escape in a boat. Spider-Man recovers from the venom and goes after them, delaying the production by another day. Realizing that Klemmer, the special effects man, probably had something to do with it, he travels to Klemmer's apartment. There he is attacked by the Spider-Squad who again manages to escape, but not before Spider-Man can tag their car with a spider-tracer. Tracking them to an abandoned barn, Spider-Man battles the Spider-Squad once more. In spite of being caught up in a giant fake spider-web, Spider-Man manages to defeat them all. When looking for Klemmer, Spider-Man finds him unconscious under a pile of hay. He suddenly realizes that someone is trying to frame Klemmer and that he's probably walked right into a trap. Sure enough, when Spider-Man gets Klemmer and the Spider-Squad to safety, the building is blown up by Anton DeLionatus, the film's producer who was hoping to cash in on the insurance of the failed project. Spider-Man tracks down DeLionatus, and easily defeats him and turns him over to the police.

anton deveres.name: Anton Deveres
anton deveres.origin: Anton Deveres was a French painter who went totally mad and was institutionalized. Breaking out, he would develop a new identity of Stefan Natas, fashioning himself to resemble story-book illustrations of the devil. Apparently independently wealthy, "Natas" set himself up on a private island complete with a private work staff. He became known for his beautiful underwater garden as well as his unsavory reputation with women, namely a number of showgirls who came to his various parties went missing, however no evidence was ever compiled that could implicate Natas of any wrong doing. Unknown to all at the time, Natas painted pictures of these girls and then decapitated the women. He would keep their heads preserved in jars filled with alcohol which he kept on display in a secret room of his home. Despite his bad reputation, Vicki Armhurst and her cousin, Bill Amhurst, would accept an invitation to see Natas' garden even though the idea was protested by her husband-to-be Dick Arbor a wealthy stock broker. That night something terrible happened and Vicki would attempt to swim back to the mainland. Nearly drowning she was rescued by the Sub-Mariner who resuscitated her on the beach. She would provide Namor with a vague warning about Natas being "a true devil" before passing out. Namor then brought Vicki back to her fiancee who was furious to learn what had happened to her. He, his sister Arline and Namor would all pay Natas a visit. When asked to account for the previous nights events, Natas would explain that Vicki and her cousin had an argument and when Natas got in the middle of it, a despondent Vicki ran off the porch and disappeared into the night. This answer would not sell Dick, who angrily punched Natas in the face before Namor broke them nup. Agreeing to discuss things in a more civil manner, Namor and Arline would leave the two to sort things out. Natas would instead knock Dick out and tie him up and go looking for the others. He would find Namor just after the Atlantean monarch found his secret room. When trying to shoot the Sub-Mariner failed, Natas would attempt to flee through a secret passage in his swimming pool to lose the Sub-Mariner -- but to no avail. Seeking to lure the hero to his shark tank, but Namor would break off their fight to rescue Arline who was then being tied up by Natas' butler. Freeing both Arline and Dick, Namor resumed his fight with Natas. When Dick attempted to interfere, Natas would stab him in the back with a knife, forcing Namor to push the madman into the shark tank where he was devoured by his own sharks. During the fight Arline found documents revealing Anton's true identity and past.

anton gofonopolis.name: Anton Gofonopolis
anton gofonopolis.origin: Prof. Anton Gofonopolis summoned many astrophysics luminaries to the Mount Olympus Observatory to announce a discovery he had observed. Once the luminaries had gathered at the observatory, the Professor said that in the past few days he had observed how a celestial body was devouring other smaller celestial bodies, such as asteroids or meteors, and becoming larger and larger as it devoured them with the fear that once it had become of an adequate size it would begin to devour the planets and after making this statement he invited the scientists to observe with the telescope to see if what he had said was true. Everyone observed and remained astonished, except Prof. Ernest Lee of the Mount Whitmore Observatory who had understood that what they were observing was not a celestial body that was devouring other celestial bodies, but rather some small animal, in this case a spider, which when placed on the lens of the telescope had given the impression of an aggressive celestial body while in fact it was the spider that was devouring other insects. In fact, by washing the lens, the phenomenon disappeared, leaving all the bystanders to enjoy a peaceful vacation at Mount Olympus.

fields.history: Prof. Anton Gofonopolis summoned many astrophysics luminaries to the Mount Olympus Observatory to announce a discovery he had observed. Once the luminaries had gathered at the observatory, the Professor said that in the past few days he had observed how a celestial body was devouring other smaller celestial bodies, such as asteroids or meteors, and becoming larger and larger as it devoured them with the fear that once it had become of an adequate size it would begin to devour the planets and after making this statement he invited the scientists to observe with the telescope to see if what he had said was true. anton gorge.name: Anton Gorge
anton gorge.origin: Anton Gorge was a sculptor who built two statues, a Statue of Good and a Statue of Evil when lightning struck the evil one and brought it to life. The evil statue pursued him throughout the castle using its great strength to corner the artist and prepared to hurl him to his doom. Just then the good statue appears and rescued the artist. After he set him down, the good statue slammed into the evil one, knocking him off the rampart, where they both plunged to their seeming destruction. The sculptor mused on the electricity bringing the bad one to life, but he'll never know what brought the good one to life to save him.

anton harchov.origin: Anton Harchov is a Russian scientist working for Project: Pegasus, studying the Sun. He was forced to abandon his friend, Ivan Vanko, in orbit around the Sun when a solar flare threatened the station Prometheus I. Two years later, Vanko returned to Earth looking for revenge on Harchov.

anton harvey.name: Anton Harvey
anton harvey.origin: thumb|left|133px|Professor Anton Harvey Anton Harvey was a spy working for the Nazis during World War II. By December of 1942 he was working as a Professor of Greek Mythology at Carson University. He would take his knowledge of Greek myth and use it for his subversive activities. Fashioning a costume based on the Greek creature known as the Medusa he then attacked the S.S. Brittany as it was undergoing construction. He killed one of the workers on the site using a close range dart gun (giving the illusion that he had a killer gaze like the real Medusa). It caused the workers blow torch to cause a massive fire that destroyed the partially completed ship. When eyewitnesses swore that they were attacked by the Medusa of legend, Harvey (in his civilian guise) used his credentials to encourage this belief. When Captain America and Bucky began investigating the reports they came to Harvey for guidance. By this point, Harvey had decided to try to eliminate Captain America by planting a challenge from the "Medusa" to Captain America, challenging the star-spangled hero to a duel to the death at Baskerville Cemetery. Cap would head off, telling Harvey to stay behind -- although Harvey insisted on showing an hour later if he had not heard back. When Captain America and Bucky arrived on the scene Harvey was waiting for them in his Medusa guise. As they fought, Harvey managed to prick Captain America with his poison, but it did not effectively kill the hero. Thinking his mentor dead, Bucky attempted to battle the "Medusa" on his own, but Harvey was too strong for the boy and managed to get away, dropping a hint that he was going to attack the nearby power station. Captain America came around shortly after and realized where the "Medusa" was going and chased after him. Cap and Bucky had Harvey on the ropes until the villain doused the lights and made his escape. Following after the Medusa's getaway car in a police vehicle, they were led to the hideout of Anton's Fifth Column network. There, they were overpowered by Nazi spies and taken prisoner. There, the "Medusa" showed the heroes a glass globe with a fake body of himself making it look like the Medusa had killed Anton Harvey. The two heroes broke free and began fighting the Nazi spies while the "Medusa" fled the scene. Captain America followed after him, and was led into the spies armory. There Captain America and the "Medusa" fought it out with bayonet rifles. Eventually, Cap shot the villain point blank in the face killing him. In the aftermath of the battle, Captain America and Bucky learned the "Medusa's" true identity and how he managed to kill his victims.

anton hellgate.name: Anton Hellgate
anton hellgate.origin: Anton Hellgate is one of the most brilliant scientific minds ever to walk the Earth, although he is slightly evil. Hellgate was a great crimelord only he met his death by Michael Badilino aka Vengeance. However though he was presumed dead what Badilino did not know is that Hellgate knew how to cheat death and, eventually returned. Over the years Hellgate created his army of super villains out of dead bodies and returned to his criminal ways. Hellgate is also responsible for bringing back a dead Danny Ketch so he can have his power. During a fight with Ketch and Johnny Blaze, Hellgate killed Johnny's wife Roxanne and transported his kids Emma and Craig away from the physical plane. Eventually Hellgate and many of his minions died at the hands of Vengeance.

anton krapotkin.name: Anton Krapotkin
anton krapotkin.origin: Anton Krapotkin was a Russian who defected from the KGB and Hydra. He has stolen a highly valuable microchip from KGB and Hydra, who want the chip back. Daredevil eventually receives the message and realizes that he must find Krapotkin or else HYDRA will kill the Black Widow. Daredevil begins networking with the underworld in an effort to find info on Krapotkin. In the midst of his search, Daredevil runs afoul of a bunch of HYDRA goons and has to beat them down. He ultimately finds Anton Krapotkin, but unfortunately Hydra finds him as well and shoots him before he can reveal the location of the stolen microchip.

anton lupeski.name: Anton Lupeski
anton lupeski.origin: The past history of Anton Lupeski is greatly unknown, however he either founded or became a member of a Massachusetts based Satanic cult, eventually becoming its leader. Among his followers he coerced a young woman named Domini into their ranks. Seeking to found a religion in order to obtain loyal followers, the vampire lord Dracula seeked out Lupeski's church in order to use it to these ends. Dracula arrived on a night that Lupeski would be offering Domini, now a faithful member of his church, to Satan to be his bride. Dracula interrupted the ceremony, posing as the Devil and took Domini to be his bride. The cult came to believe Dracula's ruse, however Anton himself soon learned that Dracula was really the fabled vampire, and not the dark lord everyone thought he was. However, he allowed the charade to continue because it suited his own ends. Anton Lupeski later officiated the Satanic wedding between Dracula and Domini, and later conducted the mystical ceremony that impregnated Domini with Dracula's child. This last ceremony was interrupted by Domini's own father who attempted to save her from the cult and be killed by Dracula. At that time, Lupeski hinted to Domini that he knew the truth about Dracula and requested to speak to her in private in the future. Lupeski next went to Dracula to express his concerns about the cult's financing, to which Dracula began organizing a party of the wealthy and elite to gather support and funds. It's during this encounter that Lupeski began plotting to destroy Dracula, finding that now that Domini was pregnant with Dracula's child -- whom Lupeski wished to use as an anti-christ figurehead in his cult, and tutor himself, was all that was required. To this end, Anton's first attempt to destroy Dracula was by manipulating the Silver Surfer into attacking Dracula, however this attempt ultimately failed when the Surfer failed to destroy Dracula. When Frank Drake and Harold H. Harold foolishly broke into Lupeski's home in an attempt to find and destroy Dracula, Lupeski and his followers took them prisoner. Rachel van Helsing came to their rescue, and despite the involvement of Dracula in the battle, they escaped when van Helsing managed to seriously wound Dracula with an arrow to the heart. Presented with an opportunity to kill Dracula, Lupeski decided not to as revelation to his followers that Dracula was really a vampire and not Satan would work contrary to his plans. Lupeski then hosted a party for Dracula and Domini to gather funds and followers for their cult. The part was crashed by Deacon Frost's vampiric Blade doppelganger and Hannibal King. During the confusion, Anton took Domini to a safe place and revealed that he knew the truth about Dracula and asked for her aid in destroying him. Domini however revealed that she knew the truth about Dracula and that she refused to allow harm to come to her husband. On Christmas Eve, the night that Dracula's child Janus was to be born, Lupeski tipped off Rachel van Helsing and the other vampire hunters to Dracula's location in the hope that they would destroy Dracula. This plan also failed when the hunters realized that Dracula's wife was giving birth to a child and were unwilling to risk the baby. Prior to revealing his son to his followers, Dracula had a meeting with Lupeski where he revealed that he was taking full control of the church, having no interest in worshiping Satan and wanting to use the cult to serve his own ends: world domination. This troubled Lupeski who attempted to sway the service so that his followers would find more importance in the young Janus rather that Dracula, hoping that when he finally destroyed Dracula he would become a martyr to his agendas. Lupeski then attempted one last time to convince Domini to help him destroy Dracula during a celebration banquet for Janus. Domini refused to take part in the attack, however she maintained her silence. Anton turned to Quincy Harker and his vampire hunters for aid once more, tipping them off to the ceremony and providing them with special guns with which to kill Dracula. Participating in the attack, Lupeski revealed his duplicity to Dracula and attempted to kill the vampire lord. However, tragedy struck when Anton attempted to make a kill shot on Dracula, and the vampire lord turned to mist to dodge it. The bullet intended for Dracula instead strike and killed Janus. The death of the child horrify everyone at the site, including the vampire hunters, putting an end to the fight. In a rage of fury, Dracula then crushed Lupeski's skull with his bare hands.

Participating in the attack, Lupeski revealed his duplicity to Dracula and attempted to kill the vampire lord. However, tragedy struck when Anton attempted to make a kill shot on Dracula, and the vampire lord turned to mist to dodge it. The bullet intended for Dracula instead strike and killed Janus. The death of the child horrify everyone at the site, including the vampire hunters, putting an end to the fight. In a rage of fury, Dracula then crushed Lupeski's skull with his bare hands.

anton mogart.name: Anton Mogart
anton mogart.origin: ===Early Life=== Nothing is known about Anton Mogart's past before he started stealing great works of art, jewels and such from locations all around the world, the thefts taking place promptly at midnight, which earned him the name Midnight Man. He lived in an opulent New Jersey mansion and stole these things simply to own them, not for the money. ===Moon Knight=== 300px|left|thumb On the 22nd day of a theft spree in New York City, Mogart stole a rare Monet oil painting from the Ramadan Art Gallery. He was later stopped by Moon Knight and fell into the river and was presumed drowned. In actuality he was carried by the current to New York and the mouth of a drainage viaduct. There the wastes in the sewer melted his face leaving him deformed. Hiding in the sewers for three days he returned to his home to find the police had taken all his stolen goods. Blaming Moon Knight for this and his deformity, he vowed vengeance. Driven insane he lived in the sewers and started collecting trash instead of treasure. He worked with Bushman who lured Moon Knight into a flooding sewage chamber with Midnight Man in it. Moon Knight was able to chisel an escape route in the brick and Midnight Man was once again washed down a river. ===Death=== Later learning that he was dying from cancer, Mogart tracked down his illegitimate son Jeff Wilde. Mogart then taught Wilde his trade secrets, but begged him not to become a criminal. Mogart then challenged Moon Knight for one last time and apparently died as a result. After he died Wilde took the alias Midnight and tried to become Moon Knight's sidekick, but instead ended up as a villain.

anton prebble.name: Anton Prebble
anton prebble.origin: Anton Prebble was an international businessman targeted for assassination by his rivals in the Paladin Corporation. They hired Elektra Natchios for the job. Over the course of two weeks, Elektra killed Prebble's bodyguards Carlo and Fred, along with fourteen other hired thugs. In the Hamptons, she executed Carter Trask and the 12 man team protecting Prebble's house. In Provence, Italy, she devastated Anton Kirscher and his team at Prebble's villa. Prebble was chased from one safehouse to another until he finally came to an oceanside estate as his last resort. Tired and empty, Prebble did nothing to fight back when Elektra fought her way through another 24 guards before finally executing him.

anton pretorius.name: Anton Pretorius
anton pretorius.origin: ===Origins=== Anton was born in South Africa and grew up as a racist, but deep in his mind he had feelings for black people which he suppressed for a long time. ===Meeting Ramonda=== After Ramonda was imprisoned for participating in a protest, Anton Pretorius met with her and returned every day to see her and freed her when he gave in to his obsession with this black woman. He then made her disappear via paperwork/bureaucracy and brought her to his mansion were he kept Ramonda hidden from the public circles. Pretorius took more and more risks to perpetuate his compulsion over the years. He sent photos to T'Chaka to make it appear that Ramonda had run off with another man. Over the years, Anton Pretorius had been sexually abusing Ramonda while keeping her at his house. He would calculatedly touch her until her body reacted and a need aroused in her body and mind. That was when he was contacted by Patrick Slade, who revealed that he knew about him and Ramonda. Pretorius also found out about the Black Panther soon coming to Slade, who wanted some money to keep his mouth shut. ===Protecting his Secrets=== In hopes to protect himself and keeping Ramonda as his own, Pretorius hired a gang of mercenaries led by Elmer Gore to kill Patrick Slade and Black Panther at their meeting. Later on, Pretorius met with Percy Boraine after the taping of another "Naked Exposures" show. This show's topic was the invasion of the Black Panther in South Africa. Pretorius wanted to meet Percy as soon as he heard of the attack on him by the Black Panther. He told Percy that the attack against him was an international incident and showed him pictures of the Black Panther, whom Percy recognized as his attacker. Pretorius assured Percy that troops were sent out to get the Black Panther. In the evening, Pretorius told the nation on TV everything about the Black Panther from his being the king of Wakanda to his illegal entrance into South Africa, and he even showed pictures of him. Pretorius assured that the parliament would take care of this situation. He later asked on TV for help from the citizens of the nation. He introduced Doeke Riebeeck to the public as the man in contact with the troops. He talked about further attacks of the Black Panther against law and order and stated that he was the son of T'Chaka. He wanted everyone to report sightings of the Black Panther to local police or Security Forces and assured everyone that the bloodshed of the Panther would soon be stopped if they all worked together. ===Hunting the Black Panther=== Now on the hunt for the Black Panther, Anton Pretorius met with Doeke Riebeeck, and the two had a heated discussion about the way the troops were allowed to proceed against the Panther. Pretorius tried to explain that this could become a real problem for them if the Black Panther was killed by their troops. He then spoke to Van der Merwe that he would like to know the reasons for the Panther's actions as much as Van der Merwe did, and Doeke once again yelled at him in anger. He then told Riebeeck that the wish of the cabinet ministers was that the violence stopped without causing more deaths. He told him that the Panther could be killed if they had to do so. Pretorius asked Van der Merwe if he didn't want to heal and gave him the okay to go with Riebeeck when he wanted to. Left alone in his bureau Anton Pretorius looked broken like the glass plate on his desk because he thought the situation would get far worse. ===Confronted by the Panther=== Later on, Pretorius continued to have Ramonda imprisoned by handcuffing her to her bed and locked the balcony's door. He then left her to check on the latest report on security measures and told her to not be depressed if this ended badly for the Black Panther. Pretorius later returned to her room and was in a panic because he couldn't contact Gore anymore and servants told him about madness outside. He met Black Panther for the first time. The Panther carried him to the balcony and threatened to drop him, but that was when Ramonda stopped him. Pretorius told the Panther that he always liked his courage and independence. He opened Ramonda's shackles to show as proof, only for Ramonda to throw them in his face. He told Ramonda that he loved her and asked her to stay with him, but instead, she punched him in the face and left with her son. Now alone, Anton Pretorius stood up on his balcony in sadness.

anton satan.name: Anton Satan
anton satan.first_appearance: Ghost Riders: Heaven's on Fire Vol 1 1
anton satan.origin: ===Project Blackheart=== Anton Satan was born as part of Project Blackheart, a program organized by Satanists with the intention of breeding an Antichrist to bring about Armageddon. Having just claimed the throne of Heaven, Zadkiel sent his angelic assassins to Earth in order to stop all biblical prophecies from happening, as that would allow him to write his own script for the end times. They killed all the children bred by Project Blackheart but Anton, who managed to escape. ===The Demon of Wall Street=== Eventually making his way to Wall Street, Anton began to work at Gourmandize Brothers Holding Inc., growing through the ranks to an executive position in just two weeks, partially due to the tragic suicide of all his supervisors. That rapid ascension caught the attention of the C.E.O., Mortimer J. Gourmandize, who congratulated Anton for his accomplishments. With Anton making no real effort to keep his identity a secret, Zadkiel's agents were able to quickly find him and attacked him inside the building he worked. He was saved from them by Jaine Cutter, an occult terrorist who wanted to maintain supernatural balance. The two ended up meeting Hellstorm the Son of Satan, who was also there to kill Anton, albeit for different reasons. Surrounded by Zadkiel's minions, Jaine and Hellstorm were forced to put their differences aside and fight together. Meanwhile, Anton took advantage of the confusion to flee, but was found instants later by Daniel Ketch. Danny took Anton to meet up with Johnny Blaze (Danny's brother and fellow Ghost Rider), the Caretaker Sara, Jaine, and Hellstorm outside the building. There, Danny presented his plan to them: days earlier, he sold his soul to the Devil in exchange for his help in bringing down Zadkiel. The only thing they needed to do was to take Anton somewhere safe and his "father" would give them the keys to Heaven. Though hesitant, the group agreed to follow Danny's plan. ===Heaven's on Fire=== While Danny and Johnny looked for a gateway to Heaven in the locations provided by the Devil, the rest of the group tried to find a gateway to Hell to deliver Anton to his "father." As Hellstorm and Jaine fought members of the Ghost Rider Assassination League, Anton restrained Sara with Master Pandemonium's help and revealed to her that she was a living portal to Heaven. After activating the portal inside Sara, Anton invaded Heaven with an army of demons he summoned from the portal on Master Pandemonium's chest. Once they arrived in Heaven, Anton and his horde found Zadkiel defeated at the feet of the Spirits of Vengeance of all eras. Anton immediately regretted his actions and fled from there as his servants were slaughtered by the Ghost Riders. Back on Earth, Anton reunited with Master Pandemonium and Blackout to get some downtime until their next scheme against humanity. ===Hellfire Club=== Kid Blackheart was present at a videoconference meeting held by Kade Kilgore to present his Hellfire Academy in order to frighten any potential rival to his rule over the Hellfire Club.

anton trask.name: Anton Trask
anton trask.origin: Anton Trask was an A.I.M. agent who was on guard when Taskmaster started harassing him. Trask stated he wanted to become Taskmaster's apprentice, for which the villain made him his apprentice. Trask's task was to control the TESS-One during a training, but he failed to tell the other agents they were forbidden to attack Taskmaster, for which he gave Trask the nickname "Todd". Taskmaster later ordered "Todd" to fight against TESS-One while he prepared himself a cup of coffee. When Taskmaster attempted to escape A.I.M. Island along with Mockingbird, who had been made prisoner, Trask attacked him from behind with the TESS-One.

anton trojak.name: Anton Trojak
anton trojak.origin: At some point, HYDRA’s Annihil-Agent 47 assumed the identity of Dr. Anton Trojak, a scientist affiliated with S.H.I.E.L.D., and used this identity to infiltrate the S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier, using HYDRA’s Epiderm-Mask Machine to create a mask that made him look like Trojak. “Trojak” oversaw the transporting of the Q-Ray aboard the Helicarrier as he promised to deliver a demonstration to Nick Fury. Later, he was contacted by the Supreme Hydra (Baron Strucker, who was impersonating S.H.I.E.L.D. agent John Bronson), and told to prepare a trap for Fury when he came to use A.U.T.O.F.A.C., the computer S.H.I.E.L.D. was using to determine the Supreme Hydra’s true identity. “Trojak” set a booby trap so that when Fury stepped on the grid in front of A.U.T.O.F.A.C., he was jolted with electricity. “Trojak” quickly set to work, installing his Aphonic Bomb to destroy A.U.T.O.F.A.C., and tied Fury to it so that he would share its fate. He then departed to activate the Q-Ray, and attempted to tear the Helicarrier apart with it, but Fury managed to free himself and attacked “Trojak”. Fury set the Q-Ray to overload as “Trojak” continued to pummel him. Seeing the damage that the Q-Ray was doing, “Trojak” triumphantly declared HYDRA’s victory as he bested Fury in combat. But just as he cried “Hail HYDRA!” the Q-Ray exploded, killing him.

anton varro.origin: Anton Varro was an antiques collector who, knowing that the wealthy Joel Luxor was interested in a statue of Horus, killed a feature writer named Jim Polhaus to take a key where he thought the statue was, but was intercepted by Moon Knight who captured him and then kidnapped him by the curator of the museum where the statue was supposed to be, Fenton Crane.

anton vierken.name: Anton Vierken
anton vierken.origin: Anton Vierken was the general of The Legion of the Undead. Vierken drank of Blade's blood, intending to use him as a human slave, in order to destroy Quincy Harker and his band of vampire hunters. Thinking Blade to be mesmerized, Vierken bragged about the Sunlight Serum to him. Vierken also set up Blade to have the cops thinks he committed murder. Blade managed to track him down and destroy him.

anton wexler.name: Anton Wexler
anton wexler.origin: Dr. Wexler is the head of the computer science department for Serval Industries. He was introduced to X-Factor members, Polaris and Gambit when he reported that someone hacked into Serval's supposed impregnable severs and allocated over ten million dollars out of their bank accounts to an unknown island located in the Mediterranean Sea. Wexler suggested to CEO Snow that he should send X-Factor to investigate since they are a strike team and handle these kind of things.

antoni mutant.name: Antoni (Mutant)
antoni mutant.origin: Antoni was a Polish mutant. After the President was manipulated by Cassandra Nova into signing an anti-mutant law that took immediate effect, Antoni was warned about it by a police officer friend of his. Antoni and his son Filip joined a group mutants trying to flee the country by boat. They were confronted by the army in the coast of the Baltic Sea, but Jean Grey and her X-Men intervened. They ensured the safety of the mutant refugees, taking them into Searebro.

antonio doombot.name: Antonio (Doombot)
antonio doombot.origin: When the alien device that powered the artificial environment of the Savage Land became compromised, its administrators lured groups of computer students from all over the world in an attempt to find help to stabilize the machine. One of these groups came from Latveria. As part of the standard Latverian problem-solving techniques, the students began to build a Doombot. Nancy Whitehead, an American student that befriended one of the Latverians, Stefan Klossner, suggested naming the Doombot "Antonio." When Stefan, Nancy, and Nancy's friend Doreen Green stumbled upon a Dinosaur Ultron that turned out to be the cause of the alien device's malfunctions, Stefan activated Antonio so it could defeat Ultron. Antonio subsequently joined forces with Squirrel Girl, Doreen's superheroic alter-ego. Unfortunately, Antonio was eventually destroyed by Ultron, who assimilated some of its components into its body.

antonio mutant.name: Antonio (Mutant)
antonio mutant.origin: Antonio was a Guadeloupean mutant with fire-based powers. Thanks to them he worked as a volcanologist. When Magma was vacationing in Guadeloupe, she met Antonio and they spent two weeks together, until Magma's vacation was over. She tried to convince Antonio to go with her to the Xavier Institute, but he refused, and instead convinced her to spend an extra week together and see if she would like to build a career in volcanology like him. Four days later, they both leapt from a helicopter into the La Cumbre volcano, deep into the lava flow, and just at that moment the M-Day occurred. Antonio lost his powers and was consumed alive by the extreme heat, dying almost immediately. Magma went crazy and blew up the volcano.

antonio aggasiz.name: Antonio Aggasiz
antonio aggasiz.origin: Antonio Aggasiz was a Brazilian mutant who was captured by an arms dealer/terrorist named Volga. Under death threat towards his family; Aggasiz would act as a interdimensional tech thief picking and nicking any and every kind of weapon, gadget or item of interest from the various alter realities for the enigmatic weaponer. on various earths he would find and test: a virulent musical number from a universe of sentient melodies, a fleshprinter made by a race called libervores and a stick of bubblegum packed with picotech which prevents rejection. But the real kickoff item he found which peaked his employers interest, was a power bestowal formula which he pinched from Earth-1287 that temporarily bestowed people with trans-human abilities, before they suffered a fatal coronary. As it turned out Volga would eventually betray his word when he tested its effects on Antonio's family. Soon after this revelation he ran but was eventually captured again and taken to a mutant internment camp located in northwestern Brazil He was located by Psylocke and with the rest of X-Force they traveled there to find him and learn what his connection was to Volga. left|thumb|Antonio's incinerated body Psylocke's reading told her that Aggasiz possessed the ability of dimensional teleportation, but that was all she could get as the place he was being held at was being blocked by psi-dampeners. The team managed to infiltrate the base with Betsy killing almost every soldier in her way, only to be confronted with seeing multiple mutants being held in holding cells. But there was no sign of Aggassiz until Meme was able to hack into the compounds computer system to find him. He was being held in a separate chamber strapped to a chair. Betsy had shut down the psi-damps while Cable approached Antonio. Antonio was very paranoid and told them to stay away from him. But Cable insisted to ask him how he ended up there, but all Antonio could do was scream out the name of his captor, Volga. Cable then turned around to see Volga come into the room floating in a green colored sphere, and started to fire concussive blasts at the members of X-Force. After that he turned his attention to Antonio and fired a powerful concentrated energy blast incinerating him on the spot. In order to find out what it was Antonio knew before he was flash fried the X-Force Team would enlist the help of another member from a different covert operations team in France, his name being Le Necrogateur, to delve into his past life and experiences before he died. Revealing a host of details from the various worlds that he stole various applied sciences from plus an eerie theme playing repeatedly in the echoes of his wake "When it comes your time to die...Sing your death song and die like a hero going home."

antonio fernandez.name: Antonio Fernandez
antonio fernandez.first_appearance: Hunt for Wolverine: Dead Ends Vol 1 1
antonio fernandez.origin: Antonio Fernández was a 16-year-old student from Barcelona. He possessed an X-Gene which hadn't manifested yet. Having stolen Mister Sinister's global genetic database, Soteira tracked down Antonio and other nine latent mutants from all over the world. Soteria killed these mutants, and delivered their corpses to the doorstep of the Xavier Institute for Mutant Education and Outreach as a warning to prevent the X-Men from looking further into Wolverine's resurrection and its connections with Soteira.

antonio guttierrez.name: Antonio Guttierrez
antonio guttierrez.origin: Trying to stop the destruction of reality following Fixer's death by his future self, the Thunderbolts tried to identify among the people who died following the appearance of the Thunderbolts Tower to compare on their database what their true fate would have been without that event, and among the identified corpses was that of Antonio Guttierrez who, compared with the database, resulted in having disappeared around that date, but in fact the corpse was there, so the Thunderbolts remedied this discrepancy by making the corpse of Antonio Guttierrez and all the others who had suffered the same fate disappear.

antonio lopez de santa anna.name: Antonio López de Santa Anna
antonio lopez de santa anna.origin: ===Texas Revolution=== In 1836 A.D., the "Battle of the Alamo" took place, a pivotal event in the Texas Revolution. Following a 13 day siege, Mexican Army under President General Antonio Lopez de Santa Anna launched an assault on the Alamo Mission killing all of the defenders, Davy Crockett, William Travis, and James Bowie. Santa Anna was later captured by the Renegades and delivered to the Texan Army's camp tied up with a note left by the Renegades.

antonio rodriguez.name: Antonio Rodriguez
antonio rodriguez.origin: ===Early Life=== Antonio Rodriguez was born in San Antonio, Texas. Not much is known about his life other than he had a criminal record and a wife named Maria Bonita Rodriguez. His wife was critically stricken with an undiagnosed disease, Rodriguez took her to every doctor who would see her, but none was able to help her. ===Armadillo=== thumb|left|Being turned into the Armadillo. In desperation, Rodriguez sought the criminal scientist Dr. Karlin Malus, an expert in the generation and bestowal of superhuman powers, whom he heard about while in prison. Malus agreed to try to cure her in exchange for Rodriguez agreeing to become his test subject and employee for an indefinite period of time. Malus subjected Rodriguez to an experimental process that combined genetic material from an armadillo with the man's human genes. Dubbing Rodriguez the Armadillo he assigned him to break into the Avengers' West Coast compound to steal the comatose body of the villain Goliath, a former subject of Malus who was being held there. Malus provided Armadillo with a serum to reduce Goliath's immense body to something he could transport discreetly. Rodriguez agreed but found himself in combat with the visiting Avenger, Captain America. Although physically superior, Rodriguez lost due to Captain America's superior combat skills. Trapped in a net by Captain America, Armadillo decided to explain his situation (after all, he had been talking about a "life or death situation" during all the fight). Taking compassion on the Armadillo's plight, Captain America refused to turn him over to the authorities. Armadillo had to leave because during the fight he had lost the serum. Captain America suggested that Armadillo could ask Malus for more serum; however, Captain America wanted to follow Armadillo to Malus' hide-out. There, Captain America injured Malus. Malus ordered Armadillo to attack Captain America, but Captain America advised Armadillo not to; as they could inadvertently damage some artifact that may be vital for Bonita. ===Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation=== After Bonita was cured by Malus (with some coercion by the Avengers), she convinced Rodriguez to keep his powers for some more time. Rodriguez then joined the Unlimited Class Wrestling Federation. The Armadillo became a major draw for the UCWF, and remained in his monstrous form to earn money for himself and his wife. Armadillo's manager was Lennie J. Feitler. He became a fan favorite and his victory over Doc Sawbones (also his first major fight, at the Madison Square Garden) was seen by Captain America himself. (...) thumb|right|Armadillo When he discovered Bonita was seeing another man, a person called Ramon, Rodriguez became grief-stricken and enraged, lashing out and attacking even Feitler and Captain America. His rampage was halted only when he jumped from the side of the Empire State Building. Gravely injured, the Armadillo was remanded to police custody. ===The Vault=== Rodriguez served time in the super-villain correctional facility known as the Vault. Truly repentant, he awaited his chance at parole. During the Armor Wars, and due to Iron Man's attack on the Vault, the facility suffered a power outage and many prisoners were freed from their cells. Armadillo tried to flee alongside fellow runaways Mister Hyde and Titania. Believing that Armadillo would slow the group, Titania would not permit Rodriguez to accompany them. Armadillo escaped on his own, eventually encountering Captain America's van which was under the protection of Vagabond. Vagabond convinced Armadillo to surrender voluntarily and return to the Vault. She also convinced him to abandon his original scheme to get revenge on his unfaithful wife. Years later, Loki in disguise appeared in the Vault to help the Wizard escape confinement. To enable this jailbreak, Loki set loose all of the other prisoners. Iron Man tried to stop them, and was attacked by many of the escaping inmates including Armadillo. Eventually, Armadillo managed to escape the Vault before Iron Man could seal it off. He was then summoned from his current moment by Isbisa, a super-villain with time-control powers. Isbisa wanted to distract the She-Hulk with some villains, including Caliban, Jack O'Lantern, Juggernaut, Master Mold, Rhino, and Sabretooth – but the villains attacked each other instead of She-Hulk, and Isbisa was easily defeated. The villains were returned to the moment they were taken from. During the Acts of Vengeance, Armadillo fell under the mind control of Doctor Doom and was ordered, alongside many other villains, to attack the Fantastic Four in Washington, D.C. while they were giving a speech to Congress. Armadillo and his pals were defeated by The Thing, the Human Torch, and the She-Thing. Armadillo was once again sent back to the Vault. Returned to his cell on the Vault, Armadillo decided he should remain in prison, resigned to serving out the rest of his sentence. Venom engineered a new breakout from the Vault, but

antonio rojo.origin: El Toro, Santo Rico's first super agent, was an early opponent of Henry Pym, then crusading against Communist agents as Giant-Man. He had rigged an election to become president of Santo Rico, but he was swiftly defeated by Giant-Man and the Wasp. Later, he was recruited by Madame X for the Bratislava Complex. El Toro acted as Madame X's aide, bodyguard, and second in command of the Bratislava-based People's Defense Force.

antony diaz.name: Antony Diaz
antony diaz.origin: Antony Diaz was a former U.S. Army Special Forces operator, and close friend of Angel Larimore while serving together with the NYPD. Larimore discovered that the mayor, Wilson Fisk, was hiring the Watchdogs and that they were masquerading as cops. He told Diaz and his brother, Tony, about this, but was beaten and killed before he could expose Fisk's corruption. In order to get revenge, Antony joined the Scourge of the Underworld program and started killing all the corrupt cops in New York City. His massacre of criminals caught the attention of Captain America, who confronted Angel's brother and discovered the truth behind the cop killings; however, they were ambushed by the Watchdogs and Antony arrived to assist Steve in the fight against them, as he had been tracking Captain America. After this, riots broke out across the city and people started to think that they were like Scourge, so they decided they had to stop him before the city got destroyed. Captain America tracked Diaz back to his residence upstate and attempted to arrest him there; however, before Steve was able to capture Scourge, he used a machine gun and committed suicide.

anu.name: Anu
anu.origin: ===Origins=== Anu was the son of Anshar and Kishar, and thus the grandson of Lahmu and Lahamu, the first two Annunaki sired by Tiamat and Apsû, respectively the primeval embodiments of the sea and of the water below the Earth. ===Early years=== Anu became the god of heaven, the Sky Father of the Annunaki and their first leader. Mating with Ki (Gaea), he sired Dagon, his first-born, then many other offspring, including Ea, Martu, Ningal, Tammuz, his first daughter Eriskegal, then his youngest daughter Inanna. He also mated with Asherah and sired Ba'al-Hadad. It was said that Anu walked among the "darkest elder gods" upon the "formless" Earth. It is unclear if Anu was included within those elder gods. ===Annunaki Civil War / Ruler succession=== At some point, Dagon succeeded to Anu. When Apsû grew tired of the younger gods, he planned to destroy them all, but was preemptively killed by Ea. That enraged, Tiamat and her son Kingu, who led Tiamat's army of monster progeny (including horned serpents, snake-dragons, demonic lions, lion-men, scorpion-men, and bull-men), led siege to Dilmun, plunging the Annunaki into a civil war. Dagon's throne was briefly usurped by Ba'al and Ea, who view their brother as ineffective, but they were driven off by Dagon's son Ullikummis. As Anu's sons were unable to defeat the enemy, his grandson Marduk proposed to led the armies of the Annunaki in exchange for becoming the Annunaki supreme leader, and slew Tiamat using heavenly weapons (mace, trident and axe) forged by Ningal. Marduk consequently replaced Anu. Although being supplanted as ruler of the gods, Anu retained a position of authority. ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== Circa 18,500, Anu was worshiped, as a minor cult, at least in the Valusian sea-port of Ostium. ===Hyborian Age=== Circa 10,000 BC, Anu was worshiped in many places, including Corinthia, and in the city later known as the City of the Plague. He dispatched the Bull of Anu on behalf of his priests. Most or all of the priests of Anu in the City of the Plague died from the plague. ===Return to Dilmun=== In about 500 AD, when monotheistic religions began to replace the Anunnaki worship, Anu produced the edict that they were to return to cut their ties with Earth and return to Dilmun (where they weren't dependent on mortal worshipers). The edict was unpopular among many Annunaki who feared losing their influence, and who were tricked by Marduk Kurios and transformed into demons. ===Third Host=== thumb|left|Anu at the Council of Godheads Around 1000 AD, he attended the Council of Godheads to discuss the threat of the Celestials. ===Modern Age=== The Annunaki that returned to Dilmun remained largely apart from Earth's affairs.

fields.history: ===Origins=== Anu was the son of Anshar and Kishar, and thus the grandson of Lahmu and Lahamu, the first two Annunaki sired by Tiamat and Apsû, respectively the primeval embodiments of the sea and of the water below the Earth. ===Early years=== Anu became the god of heaven, the Sky Father of the Annunaki and their first leader. Mating with Ki (Gaea), he sired Dagon, his first-born, then many other offspring, including Ea, Martu, Ningal, Tammuz, his first daughter Eriskegal, then his youngest daughter Inanna. He also mated with Asherah and sired Ba'al-Hadad. It was said that Anu walked among the "darkest elder gods" upon the "formless" Earth. It is unclear if Anu was included within those elder gods. ===Annunaki Civil War / Ruler succession=== At some point, Dagon succeeded to Anu. When Apsû grew tired of the younger gods, he planned to destroy them all, but was preemptively killed by Ea. That enraged, Tiamat and her son Kingu, who led Tiamat's army of monster progeny (including horned serpents, snake-dragons, demonic lions, lion-men, scorpion-men, and bull-men), led siege to Dilmun, plunging the Annunaki into a civil war. Dagon's throne was briefly usurped by Ba'al and Ea, who view their brother as ineffective, but they were driven off by Dagon's son Ullikummis. As Anu's sons were unable to defeat the enemy, his grandson Marduk proposed to led the armies of the Annunaki in exchange for becoming the Annunaki supreme leader, and slew Tiamat using heavenly weapons (mace, trident and axe) forged by Ningal. anubis.name: Anubis
anubis.origin: left|thumb|250px|Anubis ===Origin=== Anubis was born from the union of Osiris with his younger brother Seth's wife Nephthys. This infidelity caused Seth to become vengeful toward his older brother Osiris. Millenia ago, Anubis attempted to usurp the throne and enslave his great-great grandfather Amon Ra. He tried to cut out his heart and absorb the power, however Ra was able to outwit the Death God by giving it to Bast, the Panther Goddess, who ripped it from his chest. Bast took the heart to the center of Africa to hide it, however she found a tribe of great hunters who worshipped her. Before hiding the heart she decided to bless one of the warriors with the blood of Ra. The warrior was tasked with protecting the heart, creating the city of Necropolis in Wakanda, the "Greatest Nation on the Earth". Later, after Anubis' father Osiris became ruler of the Ennead, Seth murdered and dismembered Osiris in his attempt to take control of Celestial Heliopolis. As god of the afterlife, Anubis had embalmed Osiris, allowing Osiris' wife Isis to use her sorcery prowess to reassemble her husband and bring him back to life. Although Isis' magic rose Osiris from the dead, her magic would have been useless had Anubis not specially prepared Osiris' body with funeral rites and mummy wrappings. ===Hyborian Age=== As Nubis, he was worshiped in Stygia. ===Ancient Times=== Some 3,000 years ago, N'Kantu was the warrior-chieftain of the Swarili tribe in Africa. During the reign of Pharaoh Aramemnisu (Aram-Set), Egyptian warriors enslaved the Swarili and forced them to build temples to the Pharaoh. N'Kantu led a revolt against his new masters and personally slew Aram-Set inside of his own temple. As punishment for this insurrection, Aram-Set's wizard, Nephrus, used science and sorcery to transform N'Kantu into a living mummy. The temple collapsed upon them leaving N'Kantu buried beneath the Egyptian sands for millennia. Having wandered the Earth for several years, The Living Mummy returned to the land of his birth and used the mystical Orb of Ra to resurrect Nephrus. He asked Nephrus to undo the treatment that has kept him alive, so that he may finally know peace. Nephrus was unable to comply, citing that he never developed a means for reversing the process. Anubis appeared before them and made a request of N'Kantu. He has the power to grant him a final death, but first he required service. As a God, Anubis's strength relies on the power of souls, so N'Kantu would need to acquire fresh souls for him, even if such an act means committing murder. N'Kantu agreed, but vowed that he would only take the lives of evil beings. ===Against Hellstrom=== After being questioned by the police regarding the death of his neighbor Michael Taine, Daimon Hellstrom and Saripha Thames joined Amelia Sefton in a gathering at the office of Brian Anderson. They were all suddenly psychically attacked by Anubis, which Daimon managed to ward off. Afterwards he returned home and got a call from real estate agent Silas Warden who told him that he might have found a home for Daimon suiting his needs. While investigating the site of Thame's death, Daimon was attacked by the killer, a being known as Mindstar. During the fight Daimon tried to use his Darksoul, however Mindstar took Amelia hostage. This gave Daimon enough pause for Mindstar to use his powers to make Daimon believe his trident was painful to the touch. Although unable to touch his weapon, Daimon was able to command it mentally and have it blast Mindstar. Later that day, Daimon would go to visit the home picked out for him by Warden. There he would be attacked by illusions of demons and undines. He would then fall through a dimensional pit and be confronted by Mindstar, who welcomed Daimon to the Court of Anubis. thumb|left|Anubis vs. Daimon Hellstrom (Earth-616)|Daimon Hellstrom Battling Mindstar in the Court of Anubis, Daimon learned that Mindstar was really the real estate agent Silas Warden. During their battle Anubis appeared and accused Mindstar of betrayal. Anubis sent his agent, a transformed Brett Carson, to stop Mindstar. Daimon and Mindstar formed a truce, and continued to battle Anubis and his minion. Anubis revealed to Daimon that he had orchestrated events in the hopes of gaining control of Daimon's Darksoul. Trying to free Mindstar from Carson, Daimon only succeeded in sending them all through a portal into Anubis' Palace of Death and Rebirth. There the battle ended with Mindstar and Carson being restored to human forms, and Anubis sending them all back to Earth. ===Jackal Knight=== Like fellow Egyptian god Khonshu, Anubis was served by his own cult known as the Sons of Jackal, and would pick certain individuals to act as his avatars. When Randall Spector arrived to Duat he pledged his service to Anubis, becoming his avatar under the title of the Jackal Knight.

anuxa.name: Anuxa
anuxa.origin: Anuxa's race sent him to Earth as a scout. His mission was to wait for the dominant species on Earth to die out, then claim the planet for his own. He has reportedly patiently waited 1 million years for humanity to die out. He was frustrated that all the many wars of humanity failed to hasten that demise. There were always plenty of survivors. Anuxa was glad that humanity created atom bombs, a weapon with a tendency to leave no survivors. He submerged back into the iceberg he was hiding him to wait for a nuclear war which would fully annihilate humanity and allow him to claim what is left of planet Earth. Because of global warming, the iceberg melted and Anuxa awoke confused and in berserk mode. He began rampaging in Los Angeles, where Bobby Drake and his sometime boyfriend Romeo were spending time. The two heroes lured him into the ocean where Drake encased him in ice, while Romeo calmed him using his powers, determining the reason for Anuxa's behavior. In the meantime, Drake contacted S.W.O.R.D. in order to handle removing him.

anwen bakian.name: Anwen Bakian
anwen bakian.origin: Anwen Bakian and part of her family, the Bakian Clan, had managed to survive through the remains of New Xandar, which had been turned into a desolate wasteland as a consequence of the Annihilation Wave. Anwen's mother Eve had joined the Nova Corps during their most dire hour, and had not come back. Under the belief her mother chose the Nova Corps instead of her family, Anwen grew partially resentful of her, but still missed her. One night when the Bakian clan was camping in a park, the family was assaulted by the bugs, forcing them to split up. After her grandfather sacrificed himself to save her, Anwen fell in a hole in the middle of the street, where she found a bug nest that was feeding off Nova corpses. When the bugs attacked Anwen, she started beating them up out of spite for her mother and found an unfamiliar glowing rock inside one of them. When Anwen returned to the surface, the bugs surrounding her were quickly struck down by none other than Eve, who had finally returned. thumb|150px|left When Eve and Anwen reunited with Menzin and Fayne, they were being accompanied by Thanos, who claimed to have fought alongside the Novas Jesee and Sam, and was allegedly given the Time Stone before they died. Eve gave the rest of the Bakians, even the dog Zigzag, Nova Stars and deputized them as members of the Nova Corps. After becoming a Nova, Anwen realized her mother hadn't left them because she wanted, but because she had to. After they were given some training, Anwen showed to her mother the glowing rock she had found, which was identified as the Mind Stone, one of the six Infinity Stones. The Bakian clan subsequently flew to the Nova HQ, in order to recover for the night. When they arrived at the Nova HQ, it had been razed by the Annihilation Wave, and somebody had used the attack to steal the Space Stone. The Bakian clan and Thanos caught up with the thieves, Star-Lord and Gamora and forced them to land. After Eve bought the Stone from them for three Nova Stars, Gamora suggested to join them, considering they shared the common goal of wishing to put an end to the bugs. When the Bakian clan and the others were flying to the location of the next stone in Star-Lord's ship, Thanos talked to Anwen, and tried to convince that family was weakness and she was better off alone. The Bakians arrived at their destination, a desolated forest, and the Power Stone was given to them by Groot. The next location was Magus City, a sanctuary under the protection of Adam Warlock, wielder of the Soul Gem, who used it to keep the Annihilation Wave at bay. Unbeknownst to the Bakians and their allies, Adam also fed on the souls of the inhabitants of the city to power himself and keep the monsters away. When the Bakian were received by Warlock and his Knights of Xandar, a fight for the ownership of the Stone broke out because Magus didn't want to let go of the Stone. Drax the Destroyer, a being bent on hunting down Thanos, erupted into the battle, and demanded the presence of the Mad Titan. The Bakians attacked him, initially believing him to be an enemy. When Warlock used the Soul Stone on Eve to control her, she discovered the full use he gave to the Stone. Thanos tackled Warlock and saved Eve before her soul was consumed, and took the Soul Stone for himself. Thanos turned to Eve, and absorbed her soul with the Soul Stone, before taking the other four Stones from her. thumb|right|Anwen with the Infinity Gauntlet Thanos released a behemoth bug to deal with his former allies while he teleported away to find the remaining gem, the Reality Stone. Anwen suggested using Zigzag's Nova Star-enhanced smell to track down the Reality Stone from the scent of Eve's gauntlet. The Bakians arrived to Mount Terizi, and got hold of the Reality Stone before Thanos arrived. With the ability to alter reality, the Bakians were matched for the power of Thanos and his five stones. Anwen created a giant mecha out of thin air to battle Thanos, but it proved ineffective. Menzin tried to push Thanos out of reality, causing an explosion that knocked each party down. When she recovered from the explosion found the Reality Stone, Anwen was confronted by Thanos. Awen suspiciously gave Thanos the Reality Stone without a fight, and the Mad Titan boasted about the completed Infinity Gauntlet. However, the Gauntlet started acting odd. The gem that Awen had given Thanos wasn't the Reality Stone, it was a newly-created "Death Stone." Thanos quickly succumbed to the Death Stone and turned to dust. After the fight, Anwen used the Soul Stone to visit her mother, who had remained trapped within it.
