arcadia deville.name: Arcadia DeVille
arcadia deville.origin: Arcadia DeVille was a young mutant girl who was discovered and kidnapped by the Damocles Foundation. The Foundation was, in reality, a front for the genetic offshoot of humanity known as the Deviants, whose racial genetic structure is monstrously unstable. Through the Foundation, the Deviants hoped to re-start their evolution and gain genetic stability. The Foundation experimented on Arcadia to increase and control her powers. After years of torture, Arcadia escaped with the help of a more ethical Deviant, Ulysses Dragonblood, the brother of the Foundation's director Odysseus Indigo. The two were hunted by the Foundation's strike force, the Sword. Eventually reaching Kentucky, Arcadia and Dragonblood encountered the mutant hero Cannonball, who was on leave from the X-Men to visit his family. Cannonball tried to help but was overcome. Luckily, Cannonball's former team, X-Force, arrived to help drive off the Sword. During the battle, Arcadia didn't know who to trust and thought X-Force were enemies, so she transmuted X-Force member Danielle Moonstar into an immobile substance. Finally, X-Force defeated the Sword, and Arcadia restored Moonstar to her true form, somehow changing Moonstar's powers to control cosmic forces, similar to Arcadia's own. Arcadia and Dragonblood struck out on their own but eventually met up with the criminal Sledge who had a history of fighting the Foundation. Sledge sent them to stop the Deviants from resurrecting what he called a Celestial Template, which would re-start their evolution. X-Force has also arrived to stop the Deviants, and Arcadia and Moonstar were able to destroy the Template with their cosmic powers, as well as stop the evil witch Selene from absconding with it. Arcadia went her own way but began to have nightmares about a bear pursuing her. Somehow the bear became real, and when she reached San Francisco looking for X-Force, the bear was gigantic and wreaking havoc on the city. When Moonstar saw the bear, she recognized it as the Demon Bear that had haunted her when she was younger and realized that Arcadia must have accessed some of her memories in their last encounter. She and Arcadia were then swallowed by the bear. Inside, Arcadia's doll Mary Weather guided them to the truth about the bear and their connection to each other. Arcadia and Moonstar pooled their powers to disassemble the bear, and when it was done, Arcadia had turned into the Queen of the Star Swords, a villain from her childhood fantasies and a powerful version of herself from another dimension. The Queen called four versions of Moonstar from other timelines to serve her and began creating a citadel that linked to all the realities in San Francisco Bay. Moonstar and X-Force finally stopped her with the help of one of the other Moonstars and Arcadia returned to normal. Arcadia and Dragonblood parted company with X-Force again to wander the country.

arcadian.name: Arcadian
arcadian.origin: The mutant known as Arcadian battled Del Ruiz's X-Men in his lifetime. Upon death, his body was cryogenically preserved in the Bio-Shops for generations until uncovered by Garth Simenon, the Graverobber. Graverovver reanimated Arcadian as a member of his Undead to hunt down Zail Haddad. Arcadian and the Undead clashed with the X-Men until Graverobber was defeated by a neural-shock bomb, undoing his power and reverting the Undead to truly unliving status.

arch morton.name: Arch Morton
arch morton.origin: Arch Morton was the fellow inmate of Curtis Carr, the original Chemistro, and forced Carr to reveal the secret of the alchemy gun to him. After his release, Arch tried to recreate the alchemy gun, only for it to blow up in his face, but as a result it gave his hands transformative powers. As Chemistro he took work from the crime boss the Baron, who sent him to attack Power Man and frame Baron's rival Big Brother. When he attacked Luke Cage his powers were nullified by a device created by Carr and he was sent to prison along with the Baron. Chemistro teamed up with X the Marvel, Gideon Mace, Black Mariah, and Mr. Fish to kill Luke Cage when the heroes of New York City began to disappear. A short battle broke out until Luke managed to escape on the back of a moving truck.

arch e 5912.name: Arch-E-5912
arch e 5912.origin: Arch-E-5912 functioned as a pilot for the Warbound, and was fiercely loyal to the group's leader, the Hulk. Along with the rest of his warrior brethren, Arch-E-5912 accompanied the Hulk to Earth in a plot of revenge against those responsible for exiling the Hulk on Sakaar. On Earth, Arch-E self-destructed when he accidentally broke an order given to him by Korg, causing a malfunction. His head was fixed and reactivated by Gene Strausser in the aftermath of World War Hulk.

The Archangel doppelganger was destroyed by the Human Torch.

archenemy.origin: After becoming ruler of Otherplace/Limbo, Amanda Sefton (Magik) had her sidekick, Nugent, create a magical computer program to assemble all the arcane knowledge in the universe. She used this as a weapon in her war against the other splinter realms. Over many years, the stored magical knowledge evolved into the Archenemy, a force of pure magical evil. It then returned from the future to secure its own birth. It waged war against the combined might of all the Lords of Hell, but was defeated when Nightcrawler destroyed the machine in Nugent's apartment. Magik was then able to kill it with the Soulsword.

archer bryce.name: Archer Bryce
archer bryce.origin: At some point, Bryce met Ned Leeds in Europe. After the deaths of his parents, Bryce took control of their industrial research company, Bryceco. It soon fell behind its competitors, due its lack of innovation. Accompanied by his butler Victor, Bryce attended the grand opening of the Macro Science Museum. While mingling, he met Daily Bugle reporter and Leeds' widow Betty Brant. Later, Bryce watched the unveiling of the F.A.C.A.D.E. suit. Bryce dispatched Victor to summon Betty Brant for an interview, but when Victor took her to Bryce's waiting limo, he was mysteriously absent. Bryce surprised Betty with a candlelit dinner in his mansion, during which she pressed him for information on his company's interest in the FACADE armor. Bryce and Victor attended the funeral of Daily Bugle photographer Lance Bannon, for Betty's benefit, according to Bryce. Later, Bryce, Victor, Cole Cooper, and John Jameson lingered at the gravesite.

archer lyle.name: Archer Lyle
archer lyle.origin: Archer Lyle was an investigative journalist based out of Sacramento, California. Early into her career, she became a war correspondent and met rookie reporter Eddie Brock, who was investigating a scandal involving stolen gold. Archer and Eddie became friends, establishing a dead drop location at a diner in Sacramento, but ultimately parted ways once Eddie's investigation concluded. Over a decade later, Archer recieved a phone call from Eddie warning her that he was going to die and that the people responsible were members of an organization called the Absent Throne. Scolding Dylan for being so careless, Archer learned that Eddie had sent Dylan a message just before his death instructing his son to find her. Taking the trio to an old abandoned factory on the outskirts of Sacramento, Archer showed Dylan some photos of her and Eddie during their younger years and explained how they'd come to be friends. Showing Dylan her research into the Absent Throne, Archer manipulated him into asking to help her investigation and requested that he leave the Venom symbiote behind; though Dylan insisted on bringing the Sleeper symbiote along. Taking Dylan to a research facility in Plymouth, Archer arranged a trap with Alchemax CEO Liz Allan and betrayed Dylan by assisting Alchemax security forces in subduing him and Sleeper. While Archer expressed regret, Liz coldly informed her that she'd done the right thing and that Dylan and Sleeper's capture would save countless lives in the coming symbiote arms race.

archer wilson.name: Archer Wilson
archer wilson.origin: Dr. Archer Wilson was a scientist who at his own expense organized a spaceship trip on a mission to various exoplanets to prove his theory that there was a supreme being who had created every living fiber in the universe. Reached a planet where there was a temple in which all the deities worshiped in the Universe were represented, but the pilot of the spaceship killed the one who was to be the supreme being confirming Wilson's theory but releasing in the universe the total embodiment of death.

archibald corrigan.name: Archibald Corrigan
archibald corrigan.origin: Archibald was a colonel and pilot who served in the Vietnam War as well as proprietor of South Seas Skyways. While in Madripoor, he was intimidated by Bloodsport and Roughouse into ceasing to work for Tyger Tiger and instead offering his services to their employer, General Coy. After Patch came to Archie for help saving Tyger's life, he agreed to help, but intended to shoot Patch with his own gun while they were in the air, although he reconsidered moments before the plane was attacked by a fighter jet. Later on, Archie and Patch coordinated over short-wave radio to ambush and destroy Coy's supply convoy. In an attempt to rescue Lindsay McCabe and Jessica Drew from General Coy, he threatened his niece, Karma. Coy called his bluff and Bloodsport attacked Archie, before being knocked out of the way by Jessica. Charles Xavier purchased a plane from Archie to replace the one that was damaged in the battle against the Phalanx. He was killed on the orders of General Nguyen Ngoc Coy and Prince Baran.

archibald dyker.name: Archibald Dyker
archibald dyker.species: Human and an ex-golden gloves champion who broke into the South Hampton Science Institute and was accidentally transformed by a diamond-powered laser
archibald dyker.origin: Arch Dyker was a troubled child who grew to become a Golden Gloves boxing champion. Later, he turned to petty crime. While breaking into the South Hampton Science Institute to steal some precious gems, he accidentally tripped in front of a diamond-powered laser. Dyker found himself endowed with superhuman strength, diamond-hard skin and a freakish appearance. Calling himself Diamondhead, Dyker set out to make himself a master crime lord. He allied himself with Condor, was stopped in his formative attempts by the hero Nova, although he soon escaped. Dyker somehow came to the knowledge of the villain Sphinx, whom he called the Dreaded One and believed him to be a threat to life as well as his own private villainy. Dyker joined two other villains, Condor and Powerhouse, in a team dedicated to stopping the Sphinx at any cost. Called the Terrible Trio, their actions often broke the law, which brought them into conflict with Nova yet again. Condor later captured Nova and brainwashed him into becoming the leader of the Trio. Dyker violently disagreed but soon relented. The foursome used Nova's alien connections to procure a spaceship, but they were stopped by robots of the Sphinx. The Trio took whatever weapons were available and escaped, leaving Nova aboard the ship and to be stranded in space, although he later returned to Earth. Eventually, the Sphinx captured Dyker, Condor, Powerhouse, and Nova in order help him infiltrate the planet system of Xandar, the source of Nova's powers and the location of the powerful, planet-wide "living computer." As the Sphinx absorbed huge amounts of knowledge and energy from the Xandar computer, enhancing his powers dramatically, Nova led Dyker and the others (along with the Fantastic Four) in stopping an invasion of Xandar by the alien Skrulls. Ultimately, the Fantastic Four ended the threat of the Sphinx with the help of the planet-devouring Galactus. Dyker, Nova and the others stayed on Xandar as their champions. Later, the Spaceknight Rom encountered this team of "New Champions," hoping they would help him find his home galaxy. At the time, however, Dyker joined his fellow Champions (Protector, Comet, and Crimebuster) in a final battle against the Skrulls. Dyker ultimately betrayed his allies to the Skrulls, who killed Crimebuster and shunted Comet and other soldiers to another dimension. Nova confronted Dyker, but in so doing had disintegrated the bodies of Xandarian and Skrull warriors. Although he defeated Dyker, Nova was so traumatized he instantly buried his memory of the event. Defeating the Skrulls, Nova returned his friends to their proper dimension. Presumably, Dyker was imprisoned. Dyker's subsequent activities remain unknown, including his whereabouts when Xandar's population was destroyed by the space pirate Nebula. Dyker was later discovered as one of the prisoners on the planet owned by the enigmatic Stranger, although his purpose for being there remains unknown. Dyker was among those prisoners who managed to escape when the Stranger was confronted by the hero Quasar. Dyker joined with other prisoners who were natives of Earth, such as the Presence and Jack of Hearts and managed to return to Earth with their help. Eventually, Dyker resumed his life of crime and began taking assassination assignments. He was hired to kill a doctor who performed abortions but was stopped by the interference of Nova. Dyker reminded Nova of his activities on Epyrus-7, accusing him of mass murder. Nova's memories resurfaced and he battled Dyker fueled by rage and guilt. The hero Captain America offered to help, but Nova refused. He did take Captain America's glove, which contained an energy shield device and used this device to shatter Dyker's diamond-like form, apparently killing him. Captain America claimed this to be self-defense, although Nova questioned such reasoning. It was later confirmed that his shattered body would regenerate. After the events of Civil War, Diamondhead was seen stalking Nova, who was home on shore leave after the Annihilation War. Though he tried to attack him out of revenge for their previous fight, Nova effortlessly shattered his hand with a gravimetric blast and eventually the rest of his body when Diamondhead continued to resist. Nova attempted to turn in his remains to the police before they reformed into his body again, but the process was delayed due to Nova being unaware of the new Registration laws and requirements. After the war between the Avengers and the X-Men, Diamondhead came out of hiding to attack Sam Alexander, the new Nova, bearing a grudge against the entire Corps and enraged that it managed to live on after Richard's death. Though Diamondhead was able to overpower the new, inexperienced Human Rocket, Sam eventually managed to blind him with a bright flash of energy and leave him stranded on a high plateau in the middle of the Arizona desert. archibald hunt.name: Archibald Hunt
archibald hunt.origin: Archie Hunt and Jeff Knudsen were close friend for most of their lives and attended high school together. Both men desired to become great leaders. Archie eventually joined the Army while Jeff went into politics. During a campaign for the Senate, Knudsen needed to eliminate his competition, Richardson. Together Knudsen and Hunt plotted to use Hunt's military connections to send a Sentinel out to kill Richardson then self-destruct thereby destroying any evidence. The plot would result in Knudsen getting his senate seat then prompting Hunt to the rank of Colonel. However, after dropping Richardson into Lake Michigan, the Sentinel crashed in the Seyfert Salvage junkyard in Antigo. The Sentinel was then found and rebuilt by Juston Seyfert. Fearing that the reemergence of the Sentinel would lead to their convictions, Hunt and Knudesen decided to use a prototype Sentinel Mk VII-A to destroy the Sentinel and kill Juston. However, Juston was able to escape and blackmail Hunt and Knudsen into leaving them alone.

archibald stancheck.name: Archibald Stancheck
archibald stancheck.origin: Dr. Archibald Stancheck was a scientist, who was part of the team working on Count Nefaria's Project N. During his employment he left the project temporarily due to lack of payment, but he returned later when Count Nefaria resolved his financial troubles and was able the pay Stancheck's outstanding salary. As the scientists completed their work on Project N, Count Nefaria concluded that he couldn't let them live, in case they would bring their expertise elsewhere and replicate the results of the project, so he wrecked the lab, killing everyone except for Kenneth Sturdy.

fields.notes: Dr. Stancheck, along with Dr. Rachelson and Professor Sturdy, was created as part of Project N’s staff by Jim Shooter and John Byrne and fully seen and named in . Their presence during the events of was revealed in the Official Index to the Marvel Universe: Uncanny X-Men, implying they were the same people as a trio of scientists shown mutating the original Ani-Men in a flashback. This group of scientists, it should be noted, was not named and were vaguely depicted, and no reference to this procedure nor involvement by Rachelson, Stancheck, and Sturdy was mentioned in the pages of Avengers #164. That they are the same people is thus a retcon imposed by an editorial decision entirely based on a pair of super-power bestowing projects funded by Count Nefaria.

archibald strang.name: Archibald Strang
archibald strang.origin: Archibald Strang was a nobleman who was vying for the position of Germany's President Minister in the 1800s. However, his wife Lyza Strang, who was having a secret affair with Otto von Bismarck, convinced Dracula to kill him.

archie faulkner.origin: Archie Faulkner was a member of the Sleepy Hollow country club and friend of Sheriff Harry O'Connor. After the Sheriff's godson Cameron Fillardi was found dead, he and the other country club members found a bloodied Johnny Blaze asleep on the the sixth hole. They held him their until the Sheriff arrived and listened as the Sheriff assualted Johnny. Archie's fate after the Ghost Rider exploded and destroyed part of the country club is unknown but he is presumed to have been left uninjured.

archie park.name: Archie Park
archie park.origin: Park was an Iron Man Armor technician working for Stark Enterprises; he knew Jim Rhodes from having worked at the company together with him. When Rhodes was working for the NPO Worldwatch (and revealed his identity as the armored superhero War Machine to the NPO), he needed an expert to repair his armor and called in Archie Park (though he was not Rhodes's first choice), who accepted the position and, for the first day, donned a tie (still no jacket, and the cap stayed). He met Sheva Joseph and Ranald Jeffries. He was soon getting along well enough with his co-workers to attend corporate social events, such as Joseph's birthday (he presented a customized War Machine figure to her). When Rhodes went to investigate the San Revilla civil war, Archie provided him with a comms/surveillance pod to monitor radio activity there; Rhodes also used it to develop photographies.

archie simmons.name: Archie Simmons
archie simmons.origin: left|thumb|Archie Simmons.Archie Simmons was an infamous, international mercenary. His weapon of choice was the gun, and had a sewed scar on his left cheek. Fellow mercenary Marc Spector had met Simmons in person in an operation in Tanzania in which Simmons used bio-weapons; eventually, Simmons forfeited that technology, in his words because it depended on where the fickle wind blows. Along with Akkad, Banning, and LeGrange, he was hired by freelance mercenary Arsenal as a part of an elite unit to give support to the rebellion against dictator Bushman in Burunda; the whole operation being secretly funded by a drug cartel. Arsenal also recruited Spector, an expert in Bushman, and had the whole merc team gather in Marseilles, France. Noticing that Spector was unconvinced, Arsenal asked Simmons to keep an eye on Spector at every moment. Simmons drew his gun to make sure that Spector didn't leave his room, but Spector ambushed Simmons, tied and gagged him, and left to check whether Arsenal's story was true. Almost immobilized, Simmons tried to attract the attention of the other mercenaries by hitting on a door with his head, but it took them the best part of an hour to notice - and when they finally heard him, Spector was back, in his secret Moon Knight identity, to batter the mercenaries. Moon Knight defeated the other mercenaries, delivering all of them (including Simmons) to the French police. The police took them to jail in a van, but Arsenal released himself and escaped; he refused to release Simmons and the other mercenaries because they have proven to be worthless.

archie stryker.name: Archie Stryker
archie stryker.origin: Archie Stryker served as an American soldier in the Korean War, and was awarded a medal for valor in 1953. After the end of his military servic, he led a life of crime and violence. Archie and three other gang members kidnapped the plant manager of the Laserium Corporation. They attempted to use the captive to break into the company's vault, and they were unaware that the man was a Dire Wraith in disguise. When Rom arrived in search of the captive Wraith, the manager convinced the gang members to attack the Spaceknight. Rom initially swiped away the human criminals, but Archie got his hands on a nearby laser cannon and renewed his attacks. After Rom destroyed his weapon, Archie helplessly watched as Rom used the Neutralizer to eliminate the Wraith. it appeared to Stryker that a robot had mercilessly slain a fellow human. When Rom left to search for other Wraiths, the gang members were confronted by several police officers. Archie surrendered without a fight, but loudly proclaimed his intention to destroy the "alien monster" (Rom) and to avenge its human victims. Archie's hatred for Rom intrigued a nearby Dire Wraith who served as a police chief. The chief recruited Archie for a planned attack on Rom. Rom seemingly killed the chief while a defeated Archie was forced to watch. The experience reinforced his hatred for Rom. A group of Dire Wraith scientists at Project Safeguard in Maryland, led by Doctor Rachel Sweet, offered Stryker a way to strike back at Rom by donning the Galadorian armor of Firefall which they had captured from the former wearer Karas. As human physiology was so similar to Galadorian, the Wraiths were able to successfully graft Stryker to the armor. Newly empowered, he confronted Rom in battle. Rom initially held back in memory of his friend Karas and tried to tell Stryker of the true threat to humanity, the Dire Wraiths. Stryker refused to listen and Rom is forced to seriously damage him. Shortly thereafter, Sweet and others recovered the battered Archie Stryker and while they believe him unconscious he hears their schemes and realizes that Rom was telling him the truth. They remove him to Project Safeguard where he is placed in stasis. Rom arrives later to retrieve his Neutralizer that the Hellhounds had taken and is captured himself. The Wraith leader known as The Most High One gives the order for both Spaceknights to be terminated. Doctor Daedalus makes the mistake of getting too close to Stryker and is slain by the Living Flame that the Firefall armor controls. This provides a distraction that allows Rom to free himself and subdue Rachel Sweet. The Wraith taunts Rom that it would take all of a Spaceknight's power to free his Neutralizer from the force field that it is held in. Realizing the threat to humanity posed by the Dire Wraiths, Archie Stryker throws himself upon the force field, sacrificing his life so that Rom can continue his war against the Wraiths.

archie the gruesome.name: Archie the Gruesome
archie the gruesome.origin: ===Preface=== Archie the Gruesome was just one of many costumed operatives active during World War II who were recruited into the United States military. The purpose was to enlist such individuals in order to publish propaganda in the form of comic books that were commissioned by the United States military and published by Timely Comics. These comics were used to convince Americans to support the war and increase enlistment. Like many heroes recruited in this fashion, Archie's fictional exploits were few. For most of these early heroes, it was due to their deaths in combat. Presumably, much like the Young Allies, Archie's fictional exploits may be based on actual events. For the sake of clarity, however, this article differentiates between the two. ===Origins=== thumb|left|149px|Archie the Gruesome as depicted in Timely Comics circa the 1940s Archie was apparently a street sweeper who was inspired by the hero Captain America and decided to take up a costumed identity based on his idol. As "Archie the Gruesome", Archie clashed with Big Joe, a fellow street sweeper who entered into a life of crime. ===Crazy Sue's=== Archie was drafted into the military after the United States officially entered into World War II. He was among the first men recruited into the Specialized Unit, Enhanced Soldiers led by his inspiration, Captain America. Archie was the unit's medic and when they were air dropped into Guadalcanal in August 1942 to fight, he was present and provided medical attention to fellow teammates Secret Stamp, Slow Motion Jones, and others. By 1944, Archie and his comrades were pulled from the Pacific Theater to participate in the Battle of Normandy and he was airdropped with his teammates in the Norwegian village of Sainte-Mère-Église. Following their victory, the Crazy SUES celebrated with the Invaders. Archie was present with the group during their battles to liberate France from Nazis and clashing with Nazi forces in Belgium. In December 1944, Archie and his teammates were in Saarlautern, Germany. There they were attacked by Nazi forces who decimated his teammates, the Victory Boys. The lone survivor of the Victory Boys was Piotr, whom Archie attempted to give medical attention to. Realizing that Piotr's wounds were too serious to help, he was ordered by the Young Avenger to shoot Piotr full of morphine to kill the pain while the Young Avenger put him out of his misery. Archie's subsequent activities are unknown. However, evidence suggests that he died in battle during the war.

archimago.name: Archimago
archimago.origin: Archimago was a magician who claimed he had learnt secrets of an ancient Egyptian sorceress and gained magical abilities and control over the four elements: earth, wind, water, and fire. The abilities seemingly required him to maintain contact with the ground, and (as noted by the Thing) could actually be technological in origin instead of magical. He set up a performance in Central Park and upon opening his act, he encased the entire audience in a dome of ice. The Thing and the Human Torch arrived to watch the show and saw what Archimago was doing. They attempted to free the captive audience and delay to allow Reed and Sue time to arrive, so Archimago summoned water to douse out Torch's flame and blew the Thing off his feet. The rest of the Foursome arrived and Archimago prclaimed him plan to crush the Foursome to show the world his power and rule over it. He then attempted to incinerate the group, but Johnny absorbed it and used it to reignite himself. He then attmepted to use the earth beneath their feet against them but the Inivisble Woman was able to shield them. Reed deduced Archimago's connection to the ground and the foursome attacked as a group in an attempt to lift him off the ground so Sue could hold him off it. Archimago was able to hold them off at first, but the combined force eventually forced him off the ground. Sue encased him in a force field and the Thing used Reed as a slingshot and the group hurled Archimago far into the Atlantic. His landing was accompained by a flash of light as his powers shorted out. At some point, Archimago, the Chirurgeon Cleric, reformed, assumed the mastership of the Sanctum Subliminium in London, also known as the Healing Sanctum. During the Scarlet Witch's tenure as Sorcerer Supreme, she visited Archimago at the Sanctum to care for the Vishanti's chosen Sorcerer Supreme, Agatha Harkness, after her defeat at Wanda's hand. Archimago was quite dismissive of Harkness' intention behind the Uroath that she had contracted with the Vishanti at the time of the Fall of Atlantis. A few days after Agatha's departure, the Sanctum was attacked by one of Extinction King's Extinction Weapon, the Necropsy. The weapon sucked in everything in its path, and when Archimago attempted to investigate through divination, he was sucked into the maw, seemingly killing him.

architect shining ones.name: Architect (Shining Ones)
architect shining ones.origin: ===Origin and early years=== The Architect was a very ancient being and one of the Shining Ones, one of the elder races of Earth, who had landed on Earth thousands of years ago, in India. The "Shining Ones" was also the name of the early Vedic gods in India, hinting that the Shining Ones may have posed as gods at some point, or were confused as such. Eventually, the Architect became the last of his kind, and he, like many such ancient beings, was known under many names, including as the Shining One. ===Antiquity=== The Architect claimed he was present when the man that inspired the theatrical Agamemnon was slaughtered, and was somewhat involved in the whole affair. He also claimed he had met with the poets who would later be known collectively as . ===Modern Age=== The Architect lived in Panjim, Goa, India, his alien life-force contained within as a that he used as a temporary vessel, but was in pain. The Architect summoned many assassins, including Shatterhead, Bullet, Bushwacker, Blacklash, Razor-Fist, and Fatale, tasked into conducting a bloodbath in the city. He then ported Elektra's astral form to him in India, offering to call off the assassins and use his powers to let Elektra see her father, on the condition she would kill the Architect, allowing him to be rebirthed.

architect of the bifrost.name: Architect of the Bifrost
architect of the bifrost.origin: This wizard created the Bifrost, the Rainbow Bridge linking Asgard to the rest of the Nine Realms. When two spirit forms of two creatures, one from the Outer Realms, the other from the Inner Realms, fell in love but were stopped by the invisible Brona's Barrier preventing them from touching each other, this wizard was among the handful adept enough to pass through. As the two lovers promised they would pay any price, the wizard needed "two souls who long to touch", and so completed his bridge while the lovers died, without having ever seen each other but joined together for eternity inside the Prismatic Bridge of Asbru.

fields.notes: Artist Mike Deodato on creating the design for Archon: "My influence for Archon is, of course, Jack Kirby. With the mighty Marvel Universe, it almost has to be, doesn't it? As the script read: "This guy is the Archon - imagine a sci-fi guardian of the gateway to the end of reality as designed by Jack Kirby, basically. He's big and thick and powerful, either an alien or an artificial life-form, we can't totally tell. Think someone that could have been a herald of Galactus, crossed with a Celestial kind of thing, too."

archon thuvrian.name: Archon (Thuvrian)
archon thuvrian.origin: Having detected a Dire Wraith presence on Thuvria, Galadorian Spaceknights Rom, Starshine, and Terminator arrived on the planet and were confronted by the Thuvrian king Archon who was wielding advanced Dire Wraith weaponry. After a brief skirmish, the Spaceknights were taken captive. Shortly after, the Dire Wraith conspirator among the Thuvrians was revealed and killed by Terminator. Terminator, who already was psychologically compromised because of his particular circumstance as a Spaceknight who would never be human again turned his powerful black light eye beams on Archon in a fit of rage which killed the Thuvrian king.

archpriestess.name: Archpriestess
archpriestess.origin: The Archpriestess worked as a priestess of the Hand. After the death of the previous Fist of the Beast years ago, she believed the Fist's next incarnation would be found in the United States. There were those in the Hand that rejected this idea. So, the Archpriestess killed them all. Eventually, a young boy named Frank Castle caught her eye, and she believed that he was destined to be the next Fist. She once approached Castle and offered three daggers to choose from. Castle rebuffed her, but the Archpriestess was undeterred. Castle would later go on to become the Punisher. Years later, she and a group of Hand ninjas went to recruit Castle to their group, believing that he would return the Hand to glory. She tested the Punisher by pitting a large group of Hand ninjas against him. The Punisher was successful in killing them all. To incentivize the Punisher in joining the Hand, she presented to him his resurrected wife Maria. After Castle joined the Hand, the Archpriestess aided Castle with any request he asked from her. She also began training Castle to become the next Fist of the Beast. When Castle learned that the Archpriestess had killed the families of Hand ninja who had survived a fight with Ares to toughen them up, he turned on her and killed her with his katana. As Castle fled with Maria from the Hand compound, the Archpriestess resurrected herself. The Archpriestess greeted Castle when he returned because Maria was dying and explained to Castle that Maria's resurrection was incomplete and required constant treatments. So, she couldn't leave the compound; otherwise, her resurrection would end and she would die again. Castle chose to remain with the Hand in order to keep his wife alive but told the Archpriestess that he would kill her. After Castle fended off several heroes trying to save from the Hand's influence and was nearly shot to death by Maria, the Archpriestess confronted him and expressed disappointment that he wasn't killing all his enemies. She planned to kill him and then resurrect him to mold him into the perfect killer. However, Castle used the Flames of the Beast to set the Archpriestess aflame, forcing her to flee. The heroes then took Castle away. Undeterred, the Archpriestess began grooming a young killer to take Castle's place.

arctorius.name: Arctorius
arctorius.origin: Queen Arctorius was a winged steed that belonged to the Valkyries until they were all killed during the Dark Council's attack on Manhattan. When Captain America assembled the Jotunheim Strikeforce to retrieve Thor from the land of the Frost Giants, Arctorius was one of five horses who volunteered to carry the heroes in their quest. Shortly after arriving to Jotunheim, the Strikeforce was attacked by Frost Giant archers, and all the horses save for Queen Arctorius were killed. Her rider, Spider-Man, managed to communicate with her, having inadvertently equipped himself with a magical helmet that served this purpose. He shared his lament, and Arctorius stayed behind to usher the souls of her kin to the afterlife while the heroes moved forward. She then rejoined them and helped fight the Frost Giants that Thor was confronting. Arctorius was fatally injured in battle, and with her final breath, she asked Spider-Man to be buried back in Midgard. When the Strikeforce returned, they laid Arctorius to rest atop Avengers Mountain.

arcturus rann.name: Arcturus Rann
arcturus rann.origin: One million years ago, the Wanderers came to Earth from many worlds. There they faced extinction at the hands of spectral beings called Whirldemons. With a magical blade called the Sunsword, Prince Wayfinder created a new universe for the Wanderers, the Microverse, and imprisoned the demons. Wayfinder became the first Time Traveler. A descendant of the Wayfinder, Arcturus Rann was the son of Dallan and Sepsis . One thousand years ago, Commander Arcturus Rann set out on a voyage to explore the Microverse. While his conscious mind spent a thousand years in suspended animation, his subconscious made contact with the Enigma Force. At intervals, astral copies of Rann would appear and become new Time Travelers. Some of them became Shadow Priests, who set up churches devoted to worship of Dallan and Sepsis. All this activity prepared Rann to confront Baron Karza when he returned home. At the proper moment, the Shadow Priests shed their disguises and reunited with Rann, giving him the power to defeat Karza. The Enigma Force came into play again when the Spacewall between the Microverse and the Macroverse (i.e. the Marvel Universe) began to break down and the Whirldemons escaped. Rann had lost his connection to the Enigma Force, which meant that many of the Time Travelers ceased to exist (or were inaccessible). While Rann tried to restore that connection, the Microns (with the help of Doctor Strange) went on a quest to find the Sunsword, drive back the Whirldemons, and repair the Spacewall.

ard.name: Ard
ard.origin: Like the rest of the Cadre, Ard grew up in an upstate New York monastery of the Knights Templar. Once they discovered their true names and powers, the three Hellbent decided to escape, hitching a ride on a truck bound for Manhattan and arrived in Fifth Avenue. With their powers active in the middle of the city, they caused a major commotion, which drew the attention of Spider-Man, the NYPD, and Code: Blue. Shard tried to defend his sister, but eventually, Chloe Tran, who recognized the trio as Hellbent, arrived and calmed Dementia, and Spider-Man formed a web-dome to provide them all a break to regain their composure. Chloe explained their origins, but Spider-Man, while sympathetic, tried to stop them from departing without facing the consequences for their actions. When Code: Blue attacked anew, however, Spider-Man allowed the group to escape. The Hellbent trio was then accompanied by Chloe back to their former home where they found the corpses of Gregori and the rest of the monks stationed there. Chloe took the Hellbent trio to an apartment room behind an abandoned facade and false walls in a seemingly dead tenement just south of the Manhattan riverfront's Alphabet City.

ard con.name: Ard-Con
ard con.origin: ===Early=== Ard-Con was a Kree Eternal, a sub-race created a long time ago as part of the Celestials' experiments. He possibly encountered Odin, claiming that that name brought back distant memories, but also thought that Odin lived no more. Along with other Kree Eternals, Ard-Con journeyed through space and traveled to Earth 4000 years ago. After being mistaken for Gods by the Celts, all Kree Eternals soon left, save for Ard-Con who lived there for a millennium, but was soon imprisoned by Tantalus. thumb|left|as Demon Druid ===Liberation=== Ard-Con awakened due to the vibration caused by Thor after striking the ground with Mjolnir in order to turn himself back into Donald Blake, after arriving in Charring Cross, London. Freeing himself from his rock prison, the Demon Druid soon wrecked the street and blasted Thor unconscious while refusing to speak to him. He then resumed his mission, which was intending to find rest once more. In his course, he was assaulted by the British Army then once again by Thor in the district of Esher on the Portsmouth road, and one more time at Salisbury Plain in Wiltshire county, next to Stonehenge. After Thor was able to stun Ard-Con for a minute, Scotland Yard Inspector Prichard intervened, noting that the Demon Druid was merely trying to reach a portal located at Stonehenge so he could escape Earth. Now free of further attacks, Ard-Con used Stonehenge, his transportation pad, to depart Earth. ===Return to Earth=== Unable to reach his people, Ard-Con later returned at Arthur's Seat, Edinburgh, via a portal created from two tourists there, and reiterated his trick on the mutant Meggan. The intervention of Shadowcat via her phasing powers forced him to retreat, thus freeing both tourists and Meggan as well as allowing Rachel to gather some of Ard-Con's knowledge about his people's place in the process. He soon broke into Darkmoor Nuclear Research Facility where he recreated a nuclear facsimile of Stonehenge as part of his plan to power a portal so he could return to his own people. As Excalibur intervened, Shadowcat understood Ard-Con's intent, and sent Phoenix to stop Captain Britain from engaging in a fight while buying some time for her to use Widget to open him a portal to his kind and, at the same time, connect with him via Rachel's telepathy so she could apologize for their behavior. ===Return to the Kree=== The portal successfully led him home, but Ard-Con soon discovered that his people were all gone. He then renamed himself Ultimus and was soon found by the Supreme Intelligence, who revealed to him his status as the last Kree Eternal. Ultimus was then designated by Supremor as a member of the Kree Starforce along with Shatterax, Korath the Pursuer, Captain Atlas, and Dr. Minerva. They were sent to take down the Avengers who had infiltrated Kree-Lar, with Ultimus taking on Hercules and besting him as well. After a brawl, they had the Avengers surrounded. However, the co-rulers of the Kree, Ael-Dan and Dar-Benn, soon intervened and thanked the Starforce for their capture, then decided to execute both teams by locking them into a force field. At that moment, the two Kree emperors were killed by Deathbird, thus allowing the Supreme Intelligence to regain control of the Kree Empire. He then decided to send the Starforce to Chandilar, while being led by Ronan, as a form of retaliation against his attempted assassination by the Shi'ar. After teleporting themselves into the Shi'ar palace, Ultimus attacked Lilandra and dispatched Earthquake, but was distracted by Starfox long enough for Lilandra to shoot the Kree in the back. All Starforce members were soon captured and then sentenced to death by the Shi'ar, which resulted in opposition from the Avengers. The battle soon came to a halt when counselor Araki was revealed to have been replaced by a Skrull. Lilandra released Ultimus in order for him to report the Skrulls' machinations, while informing him of the disappearance of a Nega-Bomb which was originally sent to the Kree. The Starforce then escorted Lilandra, along with the Imperial Guard, as she came to claim Hala and all Kree territory as part of the Shi'ar Empire, while making Deathbird the Shi'ar viceroy and Kree ruler, and the Starforce her Imperial Guard. Under Deathbird's lead, they attacked Quasar and his allies for their intrusion into what was now Shi'ar space, thus forcing them to retreat. When the Kree Empire later regained its autonomy, all Starforce members were branded as defectors. His current fate is unknown.

ardina.origin: ===Origin=== Ardina was created magically by stabbing Silver Surfer with a ritually prepared dagger in order to create a female counterpart for him. This was done as part of a plan to restore Surfer, Namor, Doctor Strange, and Hulk to sanity. ===Defenders=== The Defenders were banished to a far off land but were rescued by Christopher Ganyrog and Pamela. They were informed by their rescuers that they were on the planet Yann, and it was Yandroth who was manipulating the The Order. As most of the heroes of Earth battled the Order, the Defenders and the Warriors of Yann joined the fight. After Yandroth's manipulations were revealed, the Order broke the mind control and helped the other heroes take down the threat. The people of Yann returned the creature to their world, and Papa Hagg invited the female Defenders to a spa two dimensions over, which they accepted. ===After Civil War=== After the Civil War, Ardina was considered by Tony Stark as a potential recruit for the 50-State Initiative.

ares.name: Ares
ares.origin: ===Ancient History=== The son of Zeus and Hera, Ares was worshiped as the god of war and golf in ancient Greece and Rome. Ares' dissatisfaction with Zeus' rule of Olympus began after Zeus' decree that worship of the Olympians should be allowed to die out. On three occasions he attempted to conquer Olympus, twice in league with his uncle Hades, god of the Olympian underworld, but each time he was thwarted through the efforts of his half-brother, Hercules, and Hercules' allies. Ares hated Hercules ever since he had killed Ares' monstrous Stymphalian Birds in the days of ancient Greece. He sired many children, including: The half-human demigod Kyknos, with the Mycenaean princess Pelopia. The giant warrior Diomedes, who became king of Thrace, with Lapith princess Cyrene. ====Trojan War==== When the Trojan War broke out, Ares and the other gods observed the events. Despite Zeus forbidding the Gods from interference, Ares acted on a few occasions: At some point, he stood by Achilles, mightiest of the Argives, during the war. In the ninth year of the conflict, after Aphrodite was wounded by Argive Diomedes while trying to protect her son Aeneas, she rushed to Ares who was watching the battle from a nearby hill. Ares entered the fight on the Trojan side, confronting Diomedes. Athena (supporting the Argives) guided Diomedes, whose blade pierced Ares, forcing him to flee back to Olympus. The same year, when Achilles slew his daughter, the Amazon Penthesilea, Ares, enraged, wished to slay him in return, but remained in Olympus, remembering that Zeus himself had lost many sons in wars and that he had forbidden Olympian interference in the war. During the tenth and last year of conflict, after Achilles' son Neoptolemus slew Eurypylus and stated that no mortal could prevail over his father's spear, Ares decided to aid the Trojans. He was immediately confronted by Athena, but their clash was prevented by Zeus' thunder, and Ares abandoned any concern he had for the Trojans. ===War with the Vodū=== Ares had heard of a great weaver by the name of Arachne and for petty reasons fabricated a rumor that she claimed to be a better seamstress than Athena herself. This caused the furious goddess to bring Arachne to Ares who decided to punish her by death. Unbeknownst to them, Arachne was the champion of the trickster god Anansi, and wanting justice for her led the African gods in a attack on the Olympians. A war broke out between the pantheons, with Ares leading his fellow Olympians, but the conflict came to an end when their respective skyfathers, Zeus and Buluku intervened. They admonished their sons for starting a war between their pantheons, and things soon went to normal. After the Mad Titan Thanos was resurrected by the Exclusion, he went on a killing spree, wiping out various Eternals. After traveling to the city of Polaria, Thanos wiped out many of its inhabitants, including Arex.

With a subterfuge he brought Namor to the fortress and convinced that he had poisoned him and rendered him helpless he told Namor that it was his intention to use his hybrid blood to create a serum of immunity and perhaps even immortality for him and his friends in the fortress, but Namor pretended of having succumbed to the poison and having discovered Gwace's true intentions, he defeated the men of his ally the Sea Marshal Strempius and captured Gwace and his allies and carried them to the surface to face justice.

argon alien.name: Argon (Alien)
argon alien.origin: ===Destiny=== Argon's father hoped that his son's noble soul would be able to calm and slow down the destruction brought by Death Metal. To this end, he lied to his son and trained him to face the android. He knew full well the outcome of the battle. Argon was training in his home dimension when his father summon him, that it was time he confront his destined. Argon happily agreed and travel to Earth-616, Canada to confront Death Metal. The battle was swift and he was clearly outmatched. However, impressed with his skills, Death Metal used his psiphon device on him, absorbing his personality. This however was what Argon's father had hoped all along as his pure and noble soul caused Death Metal to stop his rampage. However Alpha Flight soon showed up, and during the struggle Death Metal fell back into a berserk rage. It was then that Puck found Argon's body and tried taking his sword and was instead teleported to his realm. There Argon's father spoke of the gambit he had taken in sending his son to die, hoping it would slow down Death Metal. He then returned Puck to his home dimension were he instructed Aurora to use her charm powers; doing so resurfaced Argon's personality who took control of Death Metal's body and he teleported out there. ===Inside Death Metal=== Within the android body, Argon tried to keep distance from all living beings, hoping to not hurt anyone else. However he was tracked by Ratchoole without Mys-Tech's awareness of his activities. At first Death Metal resisted the urge to fight the psychic warriors sent after him, but after they began to injure him, it triggered a frenzy in him and he tore them apart. It was only after Argon resumed control that he hoped to be captured by Ratchoole's forces in hopes they could destroy him. However, a woman seeking her own death interrupted his capture and Death Metal teleported to an unknown locale, bringing her with him. There he was attack by an unknown foe. Soon the struggle against this new enemy nearly caused him to go berserk, however taking a window of opportunity, he was ready to teleport when Ratchoole stopped him, explaining that he had come to erase his mind and obtain his body. Before this could go on Mys-Tech showed up and Death Metal and Argon both agreed they could be used to destroy his body, by tricking them into believing he was working with Ratchoole. Using a massive eldritch blast they nearly succeed but upon hearing of the natives of the planet they were ready to destroy, Death Metal summoned all his will and rebuilt himself. In a move that could only be explained be Argon's influence, he fought off not only Mys-Tech but the ones seeking to destroy the planet and teleported the bomb to a dimension were the enigmatic Abyss lived. The blast destroyed the demon while Argon's father watched the event wondering about his son's role to play.

argos deviant.name: Argos (Deviant)
argos deviant.origin: Argos the Hunter was born to the race of Deviants, an evolutionary offshoot of humanity, which is cursed with an unstable genetic code causing random physical characteristics to crop up in each newborn child in the race. He became a member of Damocles Foundation and one of their elite warriors of Sword. Sword was tasked to bring defector Ulysses Dragonblood back dead or alive along with Arcadia DeVille, a Foundation test subject Ulysses helped in escaping. Ulysses and Arcadia were corned in a Kentucky coal mind by Argos. The mutant Cannonball arrived to aid the pair and managed to break Argos' staff. Then the rest of Sword arrived to aid Argos. Argos was given a new staff and and he and his team confronted Cannonball, Ulysses, and Arcadia. Arcadia used her powers to summon X-Force. X-Force managed to defeat Sword by defeating Sword's members one at a time. Bloodstone and Arcadia took possession of Sword's ship and took Argos and his team prisoner. Argos and his team later got free and were charged with defending the Damocles Foundation base and once again fought X-Force. Selene took control of the Foundation's Celestial Gatherer and used its power to turn Argos and his team into lizards. The Gatherer was later destroyed by Moonstar and Arcadia, but it's unknown if Argos and his to revert to normal.

argus lavecchio.name: Argus LaVecchio
argus lavecchio.species: Human mutated by ionic energy, now depowered
argus lavecchio.origin: ===Early Life=== Argus LaVecchio was an aspiring film director living in Los Angeles. He resided in an apartment complex managed by former actress Gloria Angel and shared the building with other entertainment-industry hopefuls, including Wonder Man, who was then pursuing an acting career. Argus dreamed of making it in Hollywood and often collaborated with his eclectic group of neighbours, including LaHoya Scripps, Aundray Phelps, Ginger Beach, and screenwriter Alex Flores. ===Exposure to Ionic Energy=== Argus and his neighbors became entangled in the fallout of Wonder Man's unstable ionic condition after they helped rescue him following an attack by Angkor, a Cambodian refugee empowered by Simon's energy. Upon returning Simon to his apartment, the group was subjected to a powerful burst of ionic discharge. While no immediate effects were observed, all present were subtly altered at a molecular level. Over time, Argus and the others began developing unique superhuman abilities. ===Becoming Visionary=== Argus discovered he had developed extrasensory vision, granting him the ability to perceive energy patterns, life forces, and even glimpses of possible future events. Embracing his new identity, he adopted the codename Visionary and joined his empowered neighbours in forming a superhero team called the Crazy Eight. Working alongside "Auteur" (Alex Flores), "Dreamer" (Jamie Flores), "Snap" (Ginger Beach), "Buff" (LaHoya Scripps), "Attractive Lad" (Aundray Phelps), "Glamour Girl" (Gloria Angel), and "Stat" (Esteban Beach), Argus helped the team battle Armed Response, a corrupt security group under the control of Lotus Newmark. They exposed the organisation’s crimes, but were soon targeted by Lotus’s hired assassins Splice and Rampage. Though victorious, the Eight suffered serious consequences, with Auteur critically wounded in the assault. ===Disbandment of the Crazy Eight=== Following Auteur's injury and subsequent spiritual entanglement in a metaphysical battle involving Mephisto, Blackheart, and the Grim Reaper, Wonder Man attempted to remove the ionic energy from the others to return them to normalcy. Most, including Argus, relinquished their powers. Only Dreamer and Stat secretly retained a portion of theirs. After Wonder Man’s apparent death fighting the alien race known as the Scatter, the Crazy Eight disbanded. Argus stepped away from superheroics and began work on a documentary exploring the world of superhumans.

argyle fist.name: Argyle Fist
argyle fist.origin: General Argyle Fist, stationed at a base in the southwestern desert, was utilizing his men and resources to find several soldiers who had vanished. When Captain America and the Falcon also disappeared, he doubled his efforts, using a new sonar device called the Hound Dog to try and locate them. The Hound Dog proved unsuccessful at first, but Fist refused to quit that easily. When the Hound Dog disappeared as well, Fist ordered his men to move in on the search. They found the Hound Dog crashed and the pilot missing, and worked to find evidence in the wreckage. Fist ordered ships to scour the area in flames, and his efforts paid off when they discovered a series of caves that acted as the enemy's headquarters. The enemy attacked, and Fist ordered his men to engage in battle. Fighting against superior numbers and technology, such as the Royalists' high frequency sound waves, Fist led his men forward. With Captain America and the Falcon battling on the inside, the Elite was quickly routed. Captain America told Fist about the Madbomb, a deadly device the Elite had developed, and they moved in to find it. While his men battled Elite operatives, Fist and the two heroes discovered that the Madbomb was missing. Fist radioed in to Washington and received orders to secure the Royalists' base. He passed along a lead about the Madbomb to Captain America and the Falcon.
